chapters.title: Chapter 1424 Dread and Lust
paragraphs: Quinlan rubbed the back of his neck and looked up at the empty sky above the square.
"So what are you planning to throw at me?"
The answer arrived without warning.
The sky split with a dull thud.

Something fell, and not gently. It came down like a thrown corpse, tearing through the air before slamming into the stone a short distance away. The impact gouged a shallow trench and sent fragments skittering across the square.
Quinlan raised an eyebrow.
The figure rolled once and came to a knee, one hand braced against the ground. Blood ran freely down a broad chest and soaked into the cracked stone beneath him.
"... Dragnar?" Quinlan said.
The Primordial Dread looked up.

One eye was swollen shut. The other burned with a glare that refused to dim. His body was a map of damage. Deep cuts. Blunt trauma. Something that looked like claw marks raked across his skin in all directions.
He spat a thick mouthful of blood and laughed once, rough and humorless.
"Kid," Dragnar growled, pushing himself upright. His massive war axe spun in his grip, metal whistling as it turned. "You might want to hide behind your mothers."
A shadow passed overhead.
Then laughter followed.
High. Wild. Unrestrained.
Quinlan looked up.

She descended slowly, wings beating with immense strength. Dark membranes caught the light as she circled, clearly in no hurry. Her hair flowed freely, framing a face split by a grin that belonged nowhere near a battlefield.
Nyxara.
The primordial succubus.
Her eyes locked onto Quinlan.
They widened.
Her hands flew to her cheeks, and a truly manic expression manifested on her demonic face.
"The baby primordial...❤️!!" she sang out, voice ringing with delighted madness. Her cheeks flushed a deep, vivid red as she leaned forward in midair, staring openly. "You came back!"
Quinlan felt several pairs of eyes snap toward him at once.
Nyxara drifted closer. She drew in a long breath through her nose, slow and deep, as if tasting the air itself. Her pupils widened. Her shoulders shuddered once, sharp and uncontrolled.
"So... rich," she murmured. "So delish❤️❤️❤️"
Her hands flew to her cheeks, and a wild look took hold of her face. "I must taste you~"

Her thick, juicy thighs pressed together, rubbing against one another as something shiny and slimy materialized right between her legs. The heart-tipped tail behind her traced loose, restless loops, brushing along her legs as it coiled and uncoiled, moving dangerously close to the slit between her legs.
Miri moved first.
She stepped in front of Quinlan, spear raised, stance set. Lumi followed a heartbeat later.
"That's close enough. Get lost."
"We will not let you corrupt our Quinnie!" Luminara decreed.
Nyxara's gaze slid over them without slowing.
She inhaled again, longer this time, head tilting back. Her wings fluttered repeatedly.
The woman looked utterly ecstatic, like a dog in heat. Merely smelling the same air Quinlan inhabited seemed to make the woman go mad.
The succubus did not care one bit for the threats thrown at her.
The tail flicked. Her smile, growing wilder by the second, stayed fixated in Quinlan's direction.
She did not stop moving closer.
Dragnar snorted and wiped blood from his mouth with the back of his hand.
"Why is he here?" Zen asked playfully. "Old friend, didn't you say you're going to keep her away?"
Dragnar's jaw clenched. His grip on the axe tightened.
"Wench keeps charming me!" he snarled.
Nyxara laughed again, sharp and pleased. Dragnar roared.
The sound tore out of him raw and unrestrained as he launched himself forward. The ground cracked under his first step as he surged toward her, axe raised high.
Nyxara's grin sharpened.

She brought her hands together, joining her thumbs and forefingers to form a heart shape in the air. The viscous fluid coating her inner thighs sizzled against her skin, instantly converting into a thick, pink-hued vapor. "[Charm of Limitless Ecstasy]!"
With a sharp exhale, she blew through the finger-frame, sending the steam rushing toward the charging Dragnar.

The mist enveloped the Primordial Dread mid-leap. Dragnar's aggressive momentum faltered as the pheromones hit his nervous system, forcing his pupils to dilate and his muscles to slacken. His axe dipped, and a glazed look of forced adoration washed over his scarred features. The charm took hold of his mind, attempting to replace his rage with a crushing, artificial desire for the succubus.
Dragnar's throat constricted as he fought the mental intrusion. The Primordial Dread wasn't to be outdone in such a manner.
He simply refused.
And when a berserker of his powers felt so strongly about something... Even magic could happen.

He bit down on his tongue until the copper taste of blood filled his mouth, using the sharp physical pain to anchor his consciousness. A guttural, agonizing scream ripped from his lungs, a sound fueled by pure, unadulterated willpower to refuse losing. The sheer volume of his roar shattered the magical trance, and his eyes cleared, burning with a renewed, crimson fury. While still suspended in the air, he wrenched his torso around and swung his massive war axe with a horizontal force that cleared the remaining pink mist from his path.

Nyxara's expression shifted from manic delight to sharp, jagged irritation. The interruption of her fixation on Quinlan triggered a spike of genuine malice. She bared her teeth, her pupils narrowing into slits as she hissed at the encroaching warrior. She found his persistence a nuisance that delayed her pursuit of the tasty newcomer.
"You are in the way!" she shrieked, her voice losing its melodic quality.

She met his strike with a violent flurry of movement. Her wings snapped forward, the sharp, bony spurs at the apex of the membranes clashing against the steel of his axe. She lashed out with her claws, aiming for Dragnar's throat, while her heart-tipped tail whipped around like a sentient spear to strike at his midsection. The two collided in a mess of sparks and shredded leather. Nyxara was landing hits, but what looked to only be shallow ones, for she had to dodge because she knew a single hit taken from a berserker that was juiced up to the degree that Dragnar meant instant death.
The more damage Dragnar took, the more powerful he became.
But soon, Dragnar's weight began to pull him back toward the earth. After all, he only jumped high into the air.

As gravity claimed him, Dragnar slammed his fist against his chest plate and, with a deep, guttural roar, he activated, "[Ascension of the Blood-Stained Path]!" channeling his internal pressure into the soles of his feet. Instead of falling, he struck the air as if it were solid granite. A shockwave rippled out from his footfall, and he began to sprint upward through the sky. Each step created a thunderous boom, allowing him to close the distance with Nyxara once more. He swung his axe in a vertical arc, the metal glowing with the heat of his kinetic energy, forcing the succubus to bank hard to the left to avoid being bisected.
And just like that, the battle of mythical proportions to the mortal onlookers continued.
Lucille, the Bloodmonger, couldn't help but gasp seeing Dragnar's display of might.
"What brutality!"
"He's clearly not in a favorable matchup, but he's holding on..." Aurora muttered.

"Actually, they're pretty well matched," Thyra spoke up. "You're right in that Dragnar prefers fighting simpler enemies, one he can exchange blows with, but he's not an ideal opponent for Nyxara either."
"It's his ability to overcome mind control..." Black Fang joined the conversation.
Due to the unexpected arrival of the two primordials, Quinlan had forgotten one very important detail.
He'd already agreed to start the trial.
The monument began to light up, starting the process.
On it, the challenge manifested.
[Trial Objective: Conquer the Primordial Succubus, Nyxara.] [Success Condition: Elicit the Shriek of Ruin; break the Succubus's resolve through carnal dominance.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1425 Consent
paragraphs: The monument began to light up, starting the process.
On it, the challenge manifested.
[Trial Objective: Conquer the Primordial Succubus, Nyxara.] [Success Condition: Elicit the Shriek of Ruin; break the Succubus's resolve through carnal dominance.] Quinlan stared at the monument.
Then he stared again.
Then he leaned closer, squinting as if the words might rearrange themselves out of embarrassment.
"...What the fuck?"
For half a second, his mind tried to supply alternatives. Misread. Glitch. Cosmic mistranslation.
"When did I become dyslexic?"
Next to him, Miri made a small, strangled sound. "N-no, Quinnie," she yelped. "You read that right."
Luminara was on him immediately, arms wrapping tight around his waist. "Absolutely not! I will not allow this trial to occur."
Quinlan barely heard her.
The monument was changing.
Lines of ancient script brightened, light threading through the stone. The square vibrated underfoot. This was activation.
The process was happening.
Then something new pressed gently against his awareness. [Does the Primordial Entity Quinlan Elysiar wish to reject the trial?]
Quinlan stiffened.
That had never happened before.
It appeared he was given the option to decline the trial.
His thoughts flicked back, unbidden, to the earlier exchange.
[It could be the most difficult Rank-Up Trial the Primordial Entity Quinlan Elysiar has ever faced.]
He swallowed.
Difficult did not begin to cover it.
Could he even do this? And not just physically. Could he shoulder what it meant, what it implied, what it would look like to everyone else?
A light tap landed on his back.
Then another.
Quinlan turned.
Kitsara stood there, tail swaying lazily. Ayame beside her, arms relaxed, expression unreadable but calm. Serika rounded out the line, hands folded behind her back, smiling softly.
All three of them were looking at him.
"Do it, Quinnie," Kitsara said brightly.
Ayame nodded once. Serika's smile deepened just a little.
"We believe in you."
Quinlan blinked. "You do understand what the trial is, right?"
Three heads nodded in perfect sync.
"Yes," they said together.
His throat tightened. "And you're okay with it?"
Ayame's lips curved, sharp and teasing. "Oh, come on, Quin. Are you really asking if we consent to you breeding a slutty succubus?"
He winced. "I mean... I'd straight up lose my mind if the roles were reversed."
Kitsara burst out laughing, tail flicking. "Yes, but we're not possessive maniacs like you. Honestly, I can't wait. Hope I get to watch."
Serika shot the foxkin a dry look before adding calmly, "Quin, we don't consider it cheating. You're doing it for our benefit. For everyone's."

Ayame scoffed, crossing her arms beneath her chest. "You already have a harem that's larger than some noble houses. At some point, accepting that our man can't keep it in his pants is simply part of the package, I feel."
Quinlan clenched his jaw at that, feeling guilty.
She saw the change in his thoughts immediately.

Ayame's scoffing expression softened. She stepped closer, uncrossing her arms, and pulled him into a tight hug. The contact was warm and grounding, full of love and adoration. She rose onto her toes and kissed him gently.

"I was messing with you, dummy... How many men in your position would even hesitate? Nyxara is literally created to be the most irresistible woman in Thalorind's history, and you're standing here worried about us and our feelings instead of diving headfirst between her legs."
She rested her forehead against his chest.
"That's why we trust you. And that's why I love you so much, my arrogant primordial..."
Quinlan tightened his arms around her without thinking.
This beyond perfect petite samurai of his fit against him easily, light and solid at the same time. He lowered his head and pressed a kiss into her lush, dark hair, breathing her floral scent in.
"You're far too amazing," he murmured. The words came out rougher than he meant.
"Hehe! But of course!" Ayame grinned, tilting her face up to steal another kiss from him. Then she pulled back just enough to look him in the eye. "Never dare forget that."
He nodded, then lifted his gaze past her.
Just because three of them were fine with it didn't mean the rest would be.
Aurora was already smiling, standing shoulder to shoulder with Lucille. The two exchanged a glance, then Aurora spoke first. "We agree with Serika."
Lucille's lips curved, approving. "It's not cheating. It's just... a different form of combat."
Blossom practically bounced on her heels. "Blossom wants to watch Master subjugate a slutty succubus!" she cheered, her blonde tail flicking behind her with open excitement.
Quinlan winced and then sighed, rubbing his face.
He turned to the elves.
Kaelira's ears were burning red. She clasped her hands together, eyes fixed somewhere around his collarbone instead of his face. "I... I don't think it's cheating either," she said softly.
She hesitated, then swallowed. "A-and maybe... watching might help me gather some courage too..."
That made him pause.

Then he grinned. Kaelira, his beloved tomboy elf, was currently the only girl he hadn't bedded yet. Just like Jasmine was for some time, Kaelira wasn't prepared for taking their relationship to the next level just yet. Quinlan didn't mind; slow-burning romance like this was warming his heart up greatly. And he knew that once they got to that level, it'd only make things feel that much better.
Then he looked at Seraphiel.

The blonde elf smiled brightly, hands behind her back, puffing her mesmerizing cleavage out. "Why not? If we grow complacent as women, that's on us. Watching Nyxara in action might make us more proficient in the war of love. I hope to master at least one new technique I never knew existed!"
"Daughter!" Sylvaris hissed, staring at her daughter like she'd grown a second head, "When did you become such a lewd woman?!"
Seraphiel flushed instantly at being called out like that. "M-mom! I'm just supporting my husband!"

Sylvaris opened her mouth. Closed it. Then turned away, rubbing her temple. After a moment, she looked at Luminara and bowed her head deeply. "I apologize, Mother of Elves. It seems I failed somewhere along the way."
"Mom!! Stop this!" Seraphiel protested.
Quinlan barely held back a laugh.
Finally, he turned to the last person.
Vex.
She hadn't looked at him once. Her arms were crossed tight, her body angled away, jaw set hard enough that he could almost hear her teeth grind.
"I don't like it," she whispered.
Quinlan nodded once, slow and respectful. He didn't argue.
"Okay, then I decline-"
"Wait!"
Vex's voice cracked the moment before Quinlan could finish.
She spun toward him, eyes wide, arms uncrossing as if she'd only just realized what she was doing. In two quick steps, she closed the distance.
"I can't believe you were about to decline it!" she blurted.

"Why not?" Quinlan asked quietly. "I won't go through with it if even one of you truly wants me to stop. This isn't a consensus vote where I'm looking for the decision of the majority. This is me asking if anyone here needs me to say no."
Vex gasped.
Her gaze dropped. Shoulders drew in. When she spoke again, her voice was smaller. "I don't want to be the reason everything gets ruined."
The words landed heavily. Her guilt was mounting and visible.
Quinlan stepped closer. He reached out, gently, and tipped her chin up until she had no choice but to look at him. His thumb rested just beneath her jaw, steady and warm.
"I will never blame you for this. Not today. Not tomorrow. Not ever."

"Hmph!!!" She glanced sideways, then back at him. "You promise? You won't stop loving me. Ever?"
Quinlan smiled and brought both hands up, cradling her face fully now.

Only that she believed him.

"...What the fuck?"
For half a second, his mind tried to supply alternatives.
Misread.
Glitch.
Cosmic mistranslation.
"When did I become dyslexic?"
Next to him, Miri made a small, strangled sound.
"N-no, Quinnie," she yelped.

Luminara was on him immediately, arms wrapping tight around his waist.
"Absolutely not!

Quinlan barely heard her.
The monument was changing.
Lines of ancient script brightened, light threading through the stone.
The square vibrated underfoot.
This was activation.
The process was happening.
Then something new pressed gently against his awareness.
[Does the Primordial Entity Quinlan Elysiar wish to reject the trial?]
Quinlan stiffened.
That had never happened before.
It appeared he was given the option to decline the trial.
His thoughts flicked back, unbidden, to the earlier exchange.
[It could be the most difficult Rank-Up Trial the Primordial Entity Quinlan Elysiar has ever faced.]
He swallowed.
Difficult did not begin to cover it.
Could he even do this?
And not just physically.
Could he shoulder what it meant, what it implied, what it would look like to everyone else?
A light tap landed on his back.
Then another.
Quinlan turned.
Kitsara stood there, tail swaying lazily.
Ayame beside her, arms relaxed, expression unreadable but calm.
Serika rounded out the line, hands folded behind her back, smiling softly.
All three of them were looking at him.
"Do it, Quinnie," Kitsara said brightly.
Ayame nodded once.
Serika's smile deepened just a little.
"We believe in you."
Quinlan blinked.
"You do understand what the trial is, right?"
Three heads nodded in perfect sync.
"Yes," they said together.
His throat tightened.
"And you're okay with it?"
Ayame's lips curved, sharp and teasing.
"Oh, come on, Quin.
Are you really asking if we consent to you breeding a slutty succubus?"
He winced.
"I mean...
I'd straight up lose my mind if the roles were reversed."
Kitsara burst out laughing, tail flicking.
"Yes, but we're not possessive maniacs like you.
Honestly, I can't wait.
Hope I get to watch."
Serika shot the foxkin a dry look before adding calmly, "Quin, we don't consider it cheating.
You're doing it for our benefit.
For everyone's."
Ayame scoffed, crossing her arms beneath her chest.
"You already have a harem that's larger than some noble houses.
At some point, accepting that our man can't keep it in his pants is simply part of the package, I feel."
Quinlan clenched his jaw at that, feeling guilty.
She saw the change in his thoughts immediately.
Ayame's scoffing expression softened.
She stepped closer, uncrossing her arms, and pulled him into a tight hug.
The contact was warm and grounding, full of love and adoration.
She rose onto her toes and kissed him gently.
"I was messing with you, dummy...
How many men in your position would even hesitate?
Nyxara is literally created to be the most irresistible woman in Thalorind's history, and you're standing here worried about us and our feelings instead of diving headfirst between her legs."
She rested her forehead against his chest.
"That's why we trust you.
And that's why I love you so much, my arrogant primordial..."
Quinlan tightened his arms around her without thinking.
This beyond perfect petite samurai of his fit against him easily, light and solid at the same time.
He lowered his head and pressed a kiss into her lush, dark hair, breathing her floral scent in.
"You're far too amazing," he murmured.
The words came out rougher than he meant.
"Hehe!
But of course!" Ayame grinned, tilting her face up to steal another kiss from him.
Then she pulled back just enough to look him in the eye.
"Never dare forget that."
He nodded, then lifted his gaze past her.
Just because three of them were fine with it didn't mean the rest would be.
Aurora was already smiling, standing shoulder to shoulder with Lucille.
The two exchanged a glance, then Aurora spoke first.
"We agree with Serika."
Lucille's lips curved, approving.
"It's not cheating.
It's just... a different form of combat."
Blossom practically bounced on her heels.
"Blossom wants to watch Master subjugate a slutty succubus!" she cheered, her blonde tail flicking behind her with open excitement.
Quinlan winced and then sighed, rubbing his face.
He turned to the elves.
Kaelira's ears were burning red.
She clasped her hands together, eyes fixed somewhere around his collarbone instead of his face.
I don't think it's cheating either," she said softly.

"A-and maybe... watching might help me gather some courage too..."

Then he grinned.

Just like Jasmine was for some time, Kaelira wasn't prepared for taking their relationship to the next level just yet.
Quinlan didn't mind; slow-burning romance like this was warming his heart up greatly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1426 Combat, Not Pleasure
paragraphs: Quinlan looked at his lovers one by one, committing the sight.
They were calm. Supportive. Too supportive.
That, more than the trial itself, weighed on him.

This was different from every other Rank-Up Trial due to being optional. Built around an act he would tear the world apart to prevent if the roles were reversed. The thought alone made his jaw tighten. Power had always come with cost, but this cost touched the hearts of people he adored more than anything in this life.

He knew his own hunger. He had never lied to them about it. Power was survival, leverage, insurance against enemies that would happily grind them down. Still, seeing the girls stand there, shoulders squared and smiles ready, made the choice feel crooked.
They did not want to be the reason he refused.
That much was obvious.

The irony that the trial's stated benefit leaned toward strengthening them rather than him did not seem to register to any of them. Or maybe it did, and they simply pushed it aside. Either way, none of them wanted to be the voice that slowed his ascent.
His gaze lingered on Ayame.

She stood with her hands resting loosely at her sides, posture relaxed in the way only a trained warrior managed. Her smile was there, beautiful and familiar, but he could see past it. The angle of her shoulders. The way her fingers flexed once, then stilled. She was steady, but there was tension beneath it.
Insecurity.
The realization soured his stomach. He hated that feeling in her. Hated that this trial, his existence, his path, had anything to do with putting it there.
Ayame met his eyes fully then, and her smile shifted. She had always been good at reading him.
"You're spiraling," she said plainly.
Quinlan exhaled through his nose. "I don't like this. I want to reject it."
"I know."

Her brows knit. "I made jokes earlier, but my opinion remains the same. This trial is an opportunity for all of us. You see it as indulgence. I see it as reconnaissance and a chance for all of us to become stronger."
He raised an eyebrow.

Ayame folded her arms. "Nyxara is a primordial succubus. Her body, her instincts, her reactions are her weapons that have been trained to the peak for millions of years. If you engage her directly, you're not just satisfying a carnal impulse. You're learning how that weapon works, how it responds to pressure, where it yields... And where it doesn't."
Her eyes stayed locked on his.
"And by extension, so are we."
Lucille's words echoed between them, though Ayame gave them sharper edges.
"This is combat," she said. "Just not the kind you're used to framing as such. Physical dominance. Psychological leverage. Control under extreme stimulation. These are all battlefields, Quin."
She uncrossed her arms and placed one hand against his chest, right over his heart. Her touch was firm yet anchoring.
"You're worried about how it makes us feel. I ask that you do not confuse concern with fragility. We are not made of glass. This challenge will test us too, and we will all overcome it together."

Her thumb pressed lightly. "The Soul Records said the trials are meant to test one's weakness. What if it were deemed that qualities like these would help you, and perhaps all of us, become a better version of ourselves? I'm confident it wouldn't just pit you against a sex demon to give you a good time or to make you evolve into a better man in bed. If you succeed, you'll reap great benefits, despite it saying it'll benefit only us. I can tell."
Quinlan looked at Ayame for a long moment.
Then he looked past her.

Kitsara's grin had softened into something approving. Serika inclined her head, calm and certain. Aurora smiled faintly, hands folded, eyes warm. Even Blossom had stopped bouncing, tail swaying in slow agreement.
They were smiling at Ayame, too.
Lucille was the first to break the quiet. She let out a small giggle. "You know... despite being the youngest among us, you're becoming a truly remarkable woman."
Aurora nodded once. "We made a good decision letting you become the right-hand woman."
Ayame slowly looked in the platinum-haired alchemist's direction. Her gaze was unimpressed. "Let me?"
Aurora blinked.

Ayame minced no words. "Back then, you were too busy pretending to be a helpless little baby so Quin would dote on you, you damned fetishist. I stepped up because someone had to keep this circus functional, not because you 'let' me."

The air shifted as she looked at them all, the girls who were present back when the decision was made. Blossom, Aurora, Lucille... Even Kitsara got a nasty side-eye look, even if she wasn't present then.
Aurora covered her mouth. Lucille looked away, lips pressed together. Even Blossom got the memo. She, too, wasn't exactly immune to having some questionable kinks.
Kitsara stared for half a second. "I wasn't even there!"
"You're the chick who jumped into a random man's arms and let him ravage you high in the skies. From what I was told, you squirted all over-"
"M-mercy!!!" The foxkin begged. "Say no more... We have an audience!"
"I'm not one to judge," the pig-faced shapeshifter shrugged. "Been there, done that."
"..." It was Kitsara's turn to send her supposed teacher a truly disappointed side-eye glance full of judgment.
Karl shrugged it off as if it never existed.
Quinlan watched the moment stretch, then grinned.
"Okay. It appears the decision has been made."
"Quinnie... you didn't even ask our opinion!" Miri whimpered. "Yes! Do you not care for the opinion of your mothers?!" Lumi whined.
"Mothers..." Quinlan chuckled. He gave them both a quick but firm hug. "I truly appreciate your concern for me, but-"

Miri was having none of it. "But what?! Nyxara is the epitome of lust! She's a frenzied woman who will eat you alive!" "Our Quinnie... Eaten alive... By a vile woman..." Lumi whimpered, her long ears drooping. The mere idea scared them both.
But...

"Mothers, put a bit more faith in this son of yours," Quinlan grinned, leaving the hug. "You've never seen me in combat, have you? I'll show you that this son of yours is more than a little baby to be doted upon."
"We know that much...!!" they protested. Alas, Quinlan had made his mind up already. With Ayame's speech, he firmly believed this was the right choice.
He turned back toward the monument.
"Let's begin."
The runes flared.
Light poured upward, and a presence brushed against his mind once more.
[The desire of the women bound to the Primordial Entity Quinlan Elysiar to witness the Rank-Up Trial has been recognized.]
[Permission granted.]
A translucent dome rose from the square, smooth and seamless, enclosing the space in shimmering clarity. Quinlan blinked.
The pressure of the dome sealed shut behind him, and the world shifted with a muted thrum. When his vision settled, he was standing alone.
Grass brushed his boots. That was it. There were no furnishings inside the dome; it was as barebones as it could be.

He turned slowly, scanning the interior of the dome. The boundary shimmered a short distance away. It was see-through, crystal clear at that. He could easily see the gazes of his companions beyond it, observing him with varied expressions.
Then the air changed.
It thickened, carrying immense warmth with it.
Space folded.
Color bled into being where nothing had stood a moment before, pooling and sharpening into form. Wings unfolded first, then legs touched down, heels sinking slightly into the soil.
She straightened.
Nyxara stood before him.
A few moments prior.
High above a village, Nyxara moved through the air with incredible grace and lethality.

Dragnar's bulk tore through cloud cover beneath her. His swings were heavy and deadly, forcing the succubus to give the bare minimum respect to her opponent. They all knew the Primordial Dread was not to be dismissed.
However, Malakar's earlier claim of Nyxara being one of the strongest among the primordials, said to Quinlan months ago, was not a lie.
She twisted midair, heel driving into his jaw. The impact snapped his head sideways and sent him tumbling. Then the world pressed back.
A presence slid across her senses.
[Primordial Entity Nyxara.]
Her wings faltered for a fraction of a second.
"Who's this?" This was the first time she'd ever seen this type of message addressed to her personally.
[The Soul Records inquire: Does the Primordial Entity Nyxara consent to partake in a challenge?].
"A challenge...?"
[The Rank-Up Trial of the Primordial Entity Quinlan Elysiar requires evaluation. Success condition: the elicitation of the Shriek of Ruin from the Primordial Succubus, Nyxara.]
Her eyes widened.
[Note: Primordial Entity Nyxara's stats will be reduced, and her arsenal of spells will be limited.]
For a heartbeat, Nyxara merely hovered in silence. Then...

"Oh," she breathed.
The air around her seemed to tighten as her grin spread, sharp and unrestrained. Thought unraveled into delight, into anticipation that made her fingers curl.
'Me?'
'Tested like that.'
'Against him?'
"Yes," she said at first, voice low and trembling with barely contained excitement.
Then she threw her head back and screamed it, the sound tearing out of her chest and echoing across the sky.
"YES! I ACCEPT!"
The world tore.
The transition was instantaneous. One moment, the wind was whipping against Nyxara's wings; the next, the world was a silent, shimmering cage of crystal-clear light.
She didn't look at the environment first. Her eyes locked onto the figure standing at the opposite end of the dome. Quinlan.

For months, he had been a tantalizing meal that was kept away from her, hidden behind a wall of overprotective mothers. She had circled him like a shark, tasting his scent from a distance, watching those two pesky obstacles, Mearie and Luminara, block her every advance.
Now, the wall was gone.

Nyxara's gaze flickered to the side, scanning the translucent boundary of the dome. There they were. Miri and Lumi stood just feet away, separated by nothing but a shimmering layer of energy. Nyxara didn't miss the way their faces were twisted in a mixture of maternal worry and fury.

A slow, predatory grin spread across Nyxara's face. She tilted her head, her eyes burning with a cruel, triumphant light. She didn't say a word, but her expression screamed it: 'I win. I am in here, and you are out there. Deal with it~' She saw Miri's hands curl into trembling fists and Lumi's jaw set so hard it looked ready to crack. The succubus let out a soft, melodic hum of pure, unadulterated smugness.
"Stop taunting my mothers," a deep, resonant voice cut through her revelry. "Let's get this over with, succubus."
Nyxara's head snapped back to Quinlan. As he spoke, his clothes didn't just fall... they receded, dissolving into motes of red fire.
Nyxara's breath hitched.

He was... magnificent. Standing tall and imposing, Quinlan's form was a masterwork of rugged masculinity, perfectly in line with Nyxara's desires. His shoulders were broad, his chest a landscape of hard, sculpted muscle. Her heart gave a violent throb against her ribs. The succubus instincts that had been honed over millions of years screamed in recognition. This... This was a luxurious meal. The tastiest. Young and fresh, untainted by the misery of time. Full of hope and ambition... Her lust didn't just rise... It erupted, a scorching wave of heat that turned her blood to liquid fire.
"Oh... you dreamy little thing," she whispered in a sultry, low purr that vibrated across the whole dome. "You have no idea what you've just invited into your bed."

Quinlan didn't look intimidated. He began to walk toward her. His stride was slow, deliberate, and radiating a level of confidence that should have been impossible for someone facing a primordial of her standing.
Nyxara's grin widened, her teeth white and sharp.

"Are you the man who is supposed to become my ruin? The one I've been waiting for?" she purred, then laughed. The sound of which was beyond thick with desire. "You're full of so much swagger. Do you truly think a few months of growth can prepare you for me?"

She began her own advance. Unlike his steady, soldier-like march, Nyxara moved with a sensual, lethal grace. She placed one juicy thigh directly over the other, her steps measured and rhythmic. With every movement, her hips swayed in an exaggerated, tempting arc while her tail lashed behind her in a slow, hypnotic whip.
The air between them began to hum with the friction of their competing auras.

"I can't help but wonder..." Nyxara murmured, her eyes raking over his muscular frame as the distance closed to mere inches. "Is this all just baseless bravado... or can you actually back it up, my adorable little Ruin~"
The gap between them vanished.

Nyxara stopped just inches from him, the heat radiating from his bare skin meeting the unnatural warmth of her own aura. She had to tilt her head back to look him in the eye, given his towering, muscular frame, but there wasn't a flicker of intimidation in her gaze. She planted her hands firmly on her hips.

"Just so we're clear, Little Ruin," she murmured, her voice vibrating against his chest, "I have no intention of going easy on you. No man - or woman - has ever made me Shriek... I will break you before I let you hear it."
Quinlan's grin only sharpened in response as his eyes locked onto hers. "I wouldn't have it any other way."
Nyxara's heart gave another violent, erratic throb.

'He is perfect❤️!' To almost anyone else, he was a threat, a rising power to be feared. But to her, a woman who had walked the planes for millions of years, who had seen empires crumble into dust, he was the most intoxicating thing in existence. He was new. He was full of that shimmering, reckless hope and raw ambition that only the young possessed, yet he carried the weight of a primordial soul. He was a newborn demigod with the eyes of a conqueror.
She found herself fawning over the sheer arrogance of his stance. It was a delicacy she hadn't tasted in so long, perhaps ever.
"I'm going to enjoy devouring every dream you've ever had...❤️" she whispered, a trace of genuine wonder breaking through her sultry mask. Quinlan opened his mouth to retort, but...
It began.
Nyxara's heart thudded so loudly it echoed like a drum within the dome. Her eyes, once a piercing violet, bled into a glowing, luminescent pink, the pupils shifting into subtle heart-like shapes.

A thick, cloying aroma began to seep from her skin, a scent of crushed roses, musk, and something ancient and forbidden. She exhaled slowly, and with that breath, a pink shroud erupted from her form. It wasn't something as simple as mist; instead, it was a heavy, swirling veil of primordial essence of lust that surged outward, swallowing the barren grass and the crystal-clear boundaries of the dome in a heartbeat.
The veil remained for long seconds, masking them both from the eyes of the outsiders, making the onlookers greatly concerned.
And as the pink haze began to recede, the world had changed.

The empty, grassy area inside the dome was gone. In its place was a chamber of impossible luxury. The ground was now covered in thick, lush red velvets and furs that felt like silk against the skin. Golden censers hung from invisible points in the air, trailing sweet smoke. And in the center of it all, dominating the space, sat a giant, heart-shaped bed, draped in sheets of crimson satin and piled high with heart-shaped, pink pillows.
Nyxara's long tongue darted out, slowly tracing the line of her upper lip as she looked him up and down one last time. The predator was no longer hunting; the meal was served.
"I will now begin eating you, Little Ruin~" she whispered with the sultriest tone Quinlan has heard in his whole life. "Prepare yourself❤️"

chapters.title: Chapter 1430 Training Stations
paragraphs: Serika let out a short, knowing laugh. "You don't have to worry about that part. I've spent enough time with him to know for a fact: Quin is a massive sucker for firm, female abs. Your 'grit' is exactly what he likes. And, by the way, you wouldn't be in the harem if he wasn't already interested in you, both body and mind. You've truly got nothing to worry about."

"..." Kaelira let out a tiny, uncertain whimper, still feeling like a fledgling bird compared to the ancient predator inside the cage, and even to her fellow mortal women, who could speak about private details like this with zero shame while they had a literal primordial audience.
Truly, it wasn't just Quinlan who lacked in the shame department, Kaelira realized.

That was when a sharp, loud clap echoed through the clearing, cutting through the chatter and the internal crises. Ayame stood with her arms crossed, her expression calm and authoritative as she looked over her friends and allies.
"Okay, it's high time for us to get productive," Ayame decreed.
Hanae raised an eyebrow. "You've made me curious. How can you be so calm?"

"I knew what I was signing up for. I believe in him. But I also know this isn't a battle that finishes in an hour, or even a few days. Quinnie is going to be fighting for his life and his evolution for many, many days. Standing here worrying won't change the outcome."

She gestured to the vast open space surrounding the dome. "Instead of wasting time on anxiety, we should embrace the present for what it is, no matter how absurd, and use the time we've been given to its maximum. Our man, our leader, is training in his own way, and we should do the same."

Then she looked the girls over once again, scoffing, "Or who here among you wants to be demoted to trophy wife status? Because I can tell you right now: if you don't make the most of this opportunity..." she paused to gesture at the primordials around them, "... you will be left in the dust. This is not a picnic but a do-or-die situation."

Suddenly, even the most worried of wives felt their hearts steel with resolve. Ayame was right. Quin was going to win; they had to believe that. And to continue fighting at his side, they had to grow stronger.

Kiryssa, the drow primordial, let out a wry, dark chuckle as she glanced at Nyxara's silhouette. "Hey, why don't we set up the training here? All of us together. That way, you girls can keep an eye on your lover and his... Duel. And if he manages to find the strength to spare a glance outside..." she paused, her eyes glinting with amusement, "...he can observe your progress, too. If he has the strength to spare, that is."

"Sounds good to me," Thyra added, nodding firmly. "This way, we can rotate the girls. Some, like the alchemist Aurora, will need specialized training from Thindlebrim, but most of you can benefit from having multiple teachers from different backgrounds."
"A training station with the dome at the center?" Hanae mused, tapping her chin before a small smile touched her lips. "Fine. Why not? Sounds like a lot of fun."

Kiryssa turned her gaze toward the two male Primordials who had been watching the proceedings with varying degrees of detachment. "What about you, Thindlebrim, Björn? I know you both have the power to set up a station here. The only question is if you are actually willing to put in the effort."

Björn let out a low, gravelly grumble that sounded like stones grinding together in a mill. But before he could voice his reluctance, Luminara stepped forward. Her expression was still tight with the lingering fury she felt toward Nyxara, and her eyes flashed with a protective light.

"I will help you with the process, Björn. I want these girls close by because we are not leaving Quinnie alone with that creature. I can tell they want it too, and I hope their presence will help Quinnie overcome the nightmarish challenge."

Björn looked at Luminara and then at Mearie, seeing the sheer maternal agitation radiating from both of them. He recognized that arguing with two turbo mothers who felt their child was being defiled was a losing battle. He let out one final, resonant grunt and nodded his head. "Fine," he rumbled. "If the two of you are so intent on being masons, I'll build the forge here. We'll need to set it up so it has noise cancellation, or you'll be the ones who drive me away within days."
"Whatever you need, just tell us," Miri nodded.

Mearie then sent a sharp glance toward Thindlebrim, but the impatient gnome Primordial threw his hands up in a gesture of total refusal. "Absolutely not!" he barked, his voice high and shrill with indignation. "My laboratory is a sanctuary of precision and silence. It is where I perform my greatest works, and I am not moving my delicate equipment into the dirt just so I can listen to days of incessant moaning! I have my standards, and I refuse to lower them!"

The girls shifted uncomfortably at his bluntness, but Aurora stepped forward before the tension could escalate. "I understand Lord Thindlebrim's concerns perfectly. The path of alchemy requires a stillness that this environment lacks. I don't mind going to his laboratory for my lessons. I can still travel back here between our sessions to cheer Quin on and check his progress."

Thindlebrim paused, his sharp eyes squinting as he looked at Aurora with a new level of respect. He clearly appreciated her dedication to the craft over the distractions of the flesh. "A sensible youth," he muttered, his tone softening. "Follow me then, student. We have much to do, and that damned woman has already cooked a fresh batch of cookies for your arrival. You'd better tell her they are tasty or she will cry and I will never hear the end of it."

Aurora beamed, her face lighting up at the prospect of both learning and sweets. "Okay!" She gave a final, encouraging wave toward the pink-tinted dome before scurrying after the gnome toward his distant workshop.

With the arrangements finalized, the area around the Rank-Up Trial transformed into a bustling camp of martial and magical industry. While Quinlan Elysiar fought a desperate, soul-searing battle for his life and his dignity against the ancient lust of Nyxara, his lovers and allies began the most grueling training session of their lives. They would not wait for him in idle prayer; they would become the weapons he needed for the wars to come.

paragraphs: The sounds of heavy masonry and the rhythmic clanging of hammers echoed across the ridge as Björn, Mearie, and Luminara began the construction of the temporary training grounds. They didn't fear his attempt at revenge toward them, but more so the chance of him snapping at one of the mortals.

Quinlan reached up, clamping onto her shoulders. He felt the silkiness of her skin and the frantic thudding of her heart through her frame. With a surge of immense strength, he shoved her backward.

His effort saw Nyxara tumbling back onto her perky butt, which hit the satin sheets with a soft thud. She looked up at him with her large, pink eyes glistening, her bottom lip trembling as she adopted the look of a sad, abandoned puppy. "So cruel... I'm kissing and pleasing you, giving all of myself to you, and this is how you thank me?" she whimpered.

Even the mere sound of her voice, the look of her face, the way she suddenly looked smaller and fragile, with her hands clasped together at her heart... All of it was designed to pierce through a man's resolve and trigger a guilty, protective instinct. She let her shoulders slump, her long hair draping over her chest as she watched him with a look of heartbreak.

Quinlan didn't hesitate. He ignored her whimpers, knowing that every sound she made was a calculated weapon in her arsenal of seduction. He climbed onto his knees, and his eyes began burning with a fierce intensity as he prepared to go on the offensive. He wasn't here to be a spectator or a plaything; he was here to dominate. To conquer the primordial succubus.

Thus, he moved with his top speed, reaching out to pin her wrists and force her down into the mattress. He intended to establish a physical pace that she couldn't manipulate, reclaiming the agency she had stolen from him.

Nyxara's begging puppy eyes disappeared as the illusion that they were, letting her previous, ecstatic expression return as she released a sudden, dense burst of pink steam from her pores. She moved under his guard, blurring into a streak until her arms wound around his waist with the strength of a python. "Got you~ I won't let go now~"

I like it," she purred, her voice vibrating through his thighs. "Now, prepare yourself to be consumed, Little Ruin ❤️"

The sensation was a total sensory overload. Her mouth was a moist, searing landscape of velvet heat that instantly enveloped his whole length in their drenched depths.

The golden censers had long since burned through their initial fuel, yet the air remained thick with a cloying, heavy haze that was a mixture of rose-scented pheromones and the metallic tang of spent primordial essence. Quinlan lay flat on his back, his chest rising and falling in shallow, jagged hitches. His skin was slick with a fine sheen of sweat and the iridescent nectar Nyxara released, making him shimmer like a statue of oiled bronze. Every muscle in his body felt like it had been shredded and reknitted a dozen times over. The battle had raged for hours, a brutal exchange of explosive energy that had pushed his Primordial Breeding Physique to its absolute threshold.

To any unaware onlooker peering through the translucent boundary, the scene would have appeared sweet, a blossoming love between man and woman. Nyxara was nestled against his side with the fluid grace of a well-fed feline. One of her smooth, toned thighs was draped heavily over his legs, pinning him down with a casual strength that belied her slender frame. Her long, shadow-like hair was a chaotic curtain over his chest as she rested her head on his shoulder, humming a low, vibrating tune that felt like a purr against his skin.
With a slow, agonizingly deliberate motion, she traced a finger over the hard planes of his pectorals, drawing small, glowing hearts into his skin with the tip of her nail.
She looked like a truly possessive girlfriend, but Quinlan knew better.

"You're so quiet now, Little Ruin..." she whispered with a voice that was best described as a sultry, honeyed rasp. She shifted, her breasts pressing firmly against his arm as she looked up at him with those swirling, pink-patterned eyes. She looked like a devoted wife, her face painted with a soft, post-coital glow of absolute contentment.

But beneath the surface of this loving embrace, Quinlan felt the true nature of his predicament. He didn't feel like a lover; he felt like prey. This woman was a terrible monster who managed to find her way into a bed with him.

He could feel her Limitless Lust Physique acting like a gravitational well, subtly tugging at his remaining life essences even while she rested. Her touch wasn't just affection; it was a constant scan for weakness, a predator's way of ensuring her meal wasn't going anywhere. Quinlan was trapped in a fortress of silk and skin. The mattress beneath him was the most comfortable surface in the world, yet it felt like a bed of nails. The woman holding him was undeniably one of the most breathtaking beings in existence, yet her warmth felt like the slow-cook of a furnace.
'She's playing with me...' Quinlan thought as he stared up at the draped ceiling. 'She's waiting for the perfect moment when my will is at its lowest to go for the final, total consumption.'

He could feel his Blessed Seed throbbing within him, responding to the proximity of the glowing tattoo on her belly. It was a biological siren call he had to fight with every scrap of his mental fortitude. He wasn't just fighting her; he was fighting his own body's desire to surrender to the ultimate siren, to pump her womb full with his essence, even if it meant killing himself in the process.

"Are you weary, my brave warrior?❤️ My adorable Little Ruin❤️" Nyxara's voice was no longer a predatory growl, but a shimmering, honeyed silk that seemed to coat the very air. "Surrender the weight of your troubles. Lay your head to rest in my embrace; let me be the sanctuary you never knew existed. I shall be your heaven and your shield, protecting you from the cold cruelties of the world...❤️"

She leaned up until her lips ghosted his ear, her breath a scalding, rose-scented mist. "I can feel your heart racing like a trapped bird... You're trying so hard to be the hero, to be the master. But here, in my arms, you don't have to be anything at all."

With a fluid motion, she pulled his head down, cradling it against the overwhelming warmth of her voluptuous bosom. She began to hum a melodic lullaby that wasn't merely sound; it was a primordial frequency, an ancient spell designed to unravel the nervous system of the most stalwart champions. Her voice was serene, a hypnotic tide that washed over his consciousness.

"You've fought so well...❤️" she whispered, her fingers moving with agonizing gentleness as she stroked his cheeks and ran her long nails through his hair. "You truly impressed me, more than any soul in all my life. Rest now, my delicious Ruin. Close those fierce eyes of yours. Tomorrow is a new day, full of new possibilities..."

Quinlan felt a wave of exhaustion hit him like a physical blow. The adrenaline that had sustained him for hours vanished, replaced by a seductive, heavy numbness. The scent of her skin, the rhythmic thud of her heart against his ear, and the vibrating lullaby in her chest all conspired to pull him into the abyss of sleep. 'Just for a few seconds...' his mind whispered, the thought appearing like a sweet mercy. 'Just to close my eyes...'
*BOOM!*
Deep within the core of his being, the Primordial Breeding Physique reacted to the encroaching slumber with the violence of a solar flare.

Abruptly, the internal flames of his resolve ignited, roaring back to life with a scorched-earth fury. His heart didn't just beat; it raged against the cage of his ribs, a frantic, thunderous demand for sovereignty.
'How dare you?' a voice within his blood snarled, a primal echo of his will. 'How dare you yield to the silk? How dare you let a seductress sing you to sleep while your women wait for your triumph?!'

The heat from his own aura surged outward, clashing violently with the hypnotic magic of the succubus. The serene, hypnotic tide of the lullaby snapped like a glass thread. Nyxara's singing dissolved into a series of breathy, manic giggles that vibrated against Quinlan's chest. She didn't look frustrated that her spell had failed; she looked utterly, dangerously enthralled.

"Oh? You're still resisting?❤️" she whispered while hugging him tighter than ever before, her voice hitching with a feverish delight. She pulled back just enough to look him in the eye, showing him her eyes, which were throbbing, luminescent hearts, mirroring the frantic rhythm of her womb tattoo.
She began to pepper his ears and neck with hot, frantic kisses, her hands roaming his body with a new, desperate speed.

"You're perfect... so resilient, so manly..." she breathed into his ear, her voice dripping with a newfound, demonic fanaticism. "No man has ever made me feel this... this infatuated. You're opening my eyes to a whole new world."
The crazed swirling of her eyes increased. "I want you to need me. I want you to adore me. I want you to tell me you love me... Kiss me like you mean to own me... ❤️"

To any other man, this would have been the ultimate victory, the hottest sex demon in existence begging for his affection. But Quinlan lay there as rigid as a mountain, his expression a mask of iron-clad focus. He ignored the scorching heat of her skin and the desperate pleading in her voice. He was no longer listening to her; he was listening to the resonance of his own soul.
The clinical, cold messages of the Soul Records echoed in the theater of his mind, cutting through the haze of pheromones like a blade of ice.

chapters.title: Chapter 1435 Realization
paragraphs: 'I am fighting her on her terms,' Quinlan realized, his internal flames settling into a steady, white-hot glow. 'I was trying to use carnal dominance, trusting my Primordial Breeding Physique and mental fortitude to get me through. I thought gritting my teeth and exerting extreme willpower would let me succeed here.'

Ayame's words echoed in his memory: 'This trial can't just be about having fun or learning to become a sex god.' It was about evolution. It was about the fusion of his will, his mana, and his biological sovereignty. If Nyxara was the ultimate predator in the warfare of carnal pleasures, he didn't need to be a bigger predator; he needed to take their duel to a different stage. He needed to turn his very essence into a conduit for his authority, to evolve the powers he wielded and turn them into something that got him through this challenge.

With renewed vigor and determination, Quinlan's shadow stretched across the heart-shaped bed, becoming a dark silhouette against the flickering pink luminescence of the dome. He loomed over the prone woman, his presence expanding until it felt like he was the one occupying every inch of the space.

Nyxara lay beneath him, her body arched in a state of perpetual, needy invitation. Seeing the change in his eyes, the shifting from desperate resistance to cold, clinical calculation, made her breath hitch. She trembled with her thighs quivering against one another and her drenched core as she looked up at him with a look of delirious excitement.
"Little Ruin?❤️ You look... Different..." she whispered with her voice becoming a fragile, tinkling bell in the heavy air.
Quinlan didn't answer with words. He merely lunged. His large hands clamped around her slender, pale neck, pinning her head back into the pillows.
"I'm going to make you regret playing with your food, succubus," he growled. His voice came as a low, masculine vibration that seemed to rattle the very foundations of the demonic woman.

Nyxara's face flushed a deep, bruised crimson as the air was restricted, but she didn't struggle, showing no fear or anger, not even a desire to escape her predicament. Instead, she leaned into his touch, her eyes becoming twin pits of violent, swirling pink fire. A manic, beautiful smile stretched across her lips as she choked out her response to his declaration.

"Regret...?" she wheezed with her heart-shaped pupils pulsing with every throb of her womb. "I am the Demon of Lust... I am the 'Want' that has no end. I am incapable of regret. Whether you are consumed by me, becoming broken and battered, or I am consumed by you, getting conquered... I accept the outcome with no regret❤️ So do your worst... break me... rewrite me..."
She took a deep breath before, with a bewitchingly mad expression, shrieked from the bottom of her very being, "DESTROY ME!❤️❤️❤️"

Quinlan didn't hesitate. He drove into her with a force that sent a shockwave through the mattress, but this time, the rhythm was different. It wasn't the desperate thrusting of a man trying to survive; it was the measured strike of a master artisan.

As he began to pound her again, Quinlan withdrew his focus from the external world. He thought back to every time he had failed to regenerate his mana in the heat of the moment. He remembered the frustration of flying through hostile skies or dodging lethal projectiles, how the mere act of noticing the danger broke the delicate trance required for his Mana Regeneration.
'The distraction is the barrier,' he realized. 'I've been trying to find silence in the noise. But what if I make the noise my silence?'
He looked down at the demoness beneath him, witnessing her head thrashing as she shrieked his name in utmost bliss.
Quinlan was no longer holding back. Every thrust was backed by the weight of his Primordial Breeding Physique, a calculated strike intended to find the breaking point of the demoness beneath him.
But Nyxara was in her element. She didn't just receive his dominance; she thrived on it, her body acting like a sponge for his fury.

Quinlan closed his eyes, attempting to sink into the cold, silent depths of his mind. 'Focus. Sink into the marrow. Pull the mana from the air, from the friction, from the soul itself...' He tried to visualize his mana pathways as steady, frozen rivers, even as his body burned.

"Don't you dare hide from me!❤️" Nyxara's voice tore through his concentration like a jagged blade. She reached up, her nails raking down his back, drawing trails of blood that sizzled against her skin. "Look at me! Bite me! MARK ME!❤️"

Her demands were a sensory hurricane. She wasn't just moaning; she was shouting obscenities with a slave's desperation. She twisted beneath him, her hips grinding in a frantic, circular motion that forced his length to graze against every sensitive nerve ending within her velvet depths.
'Stay calm... keep the trance...' Quinlan gritted his teeth with his forehead resting against hers as he tried to maintain the internal silence.
Then, she struck.

It wasn't a spell, but a tactical contraction. Her internal walls suddenly rippled in a wave-like motion, a specialized "milking" technique that hit his system with the precision of a lightning strike. The sheer, overwhelming pleasure was a physical weight that crushed his mental barriers.
"GHHH!"

Quinlan's vision whirled as his concentration shattered. His body betrayed him, his muscles seizing as he erupted into her for the umpteenth time. The release was violent, a torrential burst of Blessed Seed that Nyxara greeted with a scream of triumph, her womb tattoo flaring so brightly it blinded them both for a heartbeat.
Just like that, his flow was ruined.
Quinlan slumped for a microsecond with his breath coming in ragged gasps. He felt the drain, the familiar, sickening sensation of his life essence being sucked into the void of her womb.
"Good boy❤️" she whispered while stroking her belly. Her voice came in a panting, wet mess against his throat. "Fill me to the brim... Again, again, and again... Never stop... Never slow...❤️"
"Shut up."

The growl that left Quinlan's throat was primal. He didn't pull back. He didn't wait for his body to recover. He gripped her neck again, forcing her head back to look into his eyes, eyes that were bloodshot but burning with a terrifying, renewed conviction.
He drove back into her with even more ferocity.
'Again,' he thought, the word echoing in his soul like a drum. 'If I fail, I start again. If she breaks my focus, I build a stronger one.'

He realized he couldn't find "silence" by blocking her out. He had to incorporate her. He began to time his mana intake with her shrieks. He synced the flow of his energy with the rhythmic clenching of her body. He turned the sadistic demands she screamed shamelessly into the very fuel for his trance.

He was using the most demanding situation of his life as a forge. If he could learn to regenerate his energy while a Primordial Succubus was actively trying to drain him dry in the height of carnal warfare, no battlefield in Thalorind would ever be able to shake him again.
If he mastered this, he'd become an even more terrifying monster back in the mortal plane and take one big step toward becoming a noteworthy entity even outside of it.

"More!❤️" Nyxara cried out, her fingers digging into his biceps as she felt the shift in his aura. "Breed me into the ground!❤️ Do me until I can't string together a single sentence!❤️ I want to feel your soul burning!❤️"

"I'm going to make this bed your cage, you psychotic succubus," Quinlan whispered, his voice steadying even as his speed increased. "This is where you'll admit defeat. This is where I'll ascend to the next level and conquer your whole existence."
Nyxara's shudders and shrieks increased in their intensity upon hearing his heartfelt declaration. "Yes!!! Do it!!! Never stop!!!"
He felt it then, a tiny, flickering spark of mana returning to his core even as he continued to pound her. It was the first sign of success. The "Noise" was becoming his "Silence."
Furthermore, mana regeneration was only the start.
But to achieve all he wanted to, Quinlan still had a long way to go.
And just like this, time passed by.

But Nyxara was in her element.
She didn't just receive his dominance; she thrived on it, her body acting like a sponge for his fury.
Quinlan closed his eyes, attempting to sink into the cold, silent depths of his mind. 'Focus.
Sink into the marrow.
Pull the mana from the air, from the friction, from the soul itself...' He tried to visualize his mana pathways as steady, frozen rivers, even as his body burned.
"Don't you dare hide from me!❤️" Nyxara's voice tore through his concentration like a jagged blade.
She reached up, her nails raking down his back, drawing trails of blood that sizzled against her skin.
"Look at me!
Bite me!
MARK ME!❤️"
Her demands were a sensory hurricane.
She wasn't just moaning; she was shouting obscenities with a slave's desperation.
She twisted beneath him, her hips grinding in a frantic, circular motion that forced his length to graze against every sensitive nerve ending within her velvet depths.
'Stay calm... keep the trance...' Quinlan gritted his teeth with his forehead resting against hers as he tried to maintain the internal silence.
Then, she struck.
It wasn't a spell, but a tactical contraction.
Her internal walls suddenly rippled in a wave-like motion, a specialized "milking" technique that hit his system with the precision of a lightning strike.
The sheer, overwhelming pleasure was a physical weight that crushed his mental barriers.
"GHHH!"
Quinlan's vision whirled as his concentration shattered.
His body betrayed him, his muscles seizing as he erupted into her for the umpteenth time.
The release was violent, a torrential burst of Blessed Seed that Nyxara greeted with a scream of triumph, her womb tattoo flaring so brightly it blinded them both for a heartbeat.
Just like that, his flow was ruined.
Quinlan slumped for a microsecond with his breath coming in ragged gasps.
He felt the drain, the familiar, sickening sensation of his life essence being sucked into the void of her womb.
"Good boy❤️" she whispered while stroking her belly.
Her voice came in a panting, wet mess against his throat.
"Fill me to the brim...
Again, again, and again...
Never stop...
Never slow...❤️"
"Shut up."
The growl that left Quinlan's throat was primal.
He didn't pull back.
He didn't wait for his body to recover.
He gripped her neck again, forcing her head back to look into his eyes, eyes that were bloodshot but burning with a terrifying, renewed conviction.
He drove back into her with even more ferocity.
'Again,' he thought, the word echoing in his soul like a drum. 'If I fail, I start again.
If she breaks my focus, I build a stronger one.'
He realized he couldn't find "silence" by blocking her out.
He had to incorporate her.
He began to time his mana intake with her shrieks.
He synced the flow of his energy with the rhythmic clenching of her body.
He turned the sadistic demands she screamed shamelessly into the very fuel for his trance.
He was using the most demanding situation of his life as a forge.

If he could learn to regenerate his energy while a Primordial Succubus was actively trying to drain him dry in the height of carnal warfare, no battlefield in Thalorind would ever be able to shake him again.
If he mastered this, he'd become an even more terrifying monster back in the mortal plane and take one big step toward becoming a noteworthy entity even outside of it.
"More!❤️" Nyxara cried out, her fingers digging into his biceps as she felt the shift in his aura.
"Breed me into the ground!❤️ Do me until I can't string together a single sentence!❤️ I want to feel your soul burning!❤️"
"I'm going to make this bed your cage, you psychotic succubus," Quinlan whispered, his voice steadying even as his speed increased.
"This is where you'll admit defeat.
This is where I'll ascend to the next level and conquer your whole existence."
Nyxara's shudders and shrieks increased in their intensity upon hearing his heartfelt declaration.
"Yes!!!
Do it!!!
Never stop!!!"
He felt it then, a tiny, flickering spark of mana returning to his core even as he continued to pound her.
It was the first sign of success.
The "Noise" was becoming his "Silence."
Furthermore, mana regeneration was only the start.
But to achieve all he wanted to, Quinlan still had a long way to go.
And just like this, time passed by.

chapters.title: Chapter 1436 Teenage Curiosity
paragraphs: The first thing the girls noticed was that the view only worked one way.

They could see Quinlan clearly through the dome, noting every shift of his duel. What they could not do was draw his attention. Shouting did nothing. Gestures went unanswered. When Lucille tried waving both arms over her head, Quinlan did not react at all. Whether it was because of Nyxara's pink magical mist or the basic property of the dome they didn't know, but neither did it really matter.

They saw how he fought this unconventional battle of his with all he had and more. They also saw how Quinlan was trying to adapt, trying multiple strategies. They saw how he was brought to the brink of defeat multiple times, only for Nyxara to never deliver a finishing blow, instead nuzzling up to him and waiting for him to regain his strength and wits.
It was clear she was playing with their lover, and that angered all women present.
However, slowly, the tide began shifting, making it clear Quinlan wasn't going to throw in the towel anytime soon. He was busy making his counter attack right now.
At this point, all the girls understood he was going to be at this for a long time.
Which meant Ayame's earlier words stopped being advice and turned into consensus.
They broke apart without discussion.
Kiryssa had already moved to the edge of the clearing, where the ground dipped, and the light thinned. She did not call for students. She simply drew a thin blade from her sleeve and waited.
Iris reached her first, leading the charge.
Blossom followed with claws sliding free from her gauntlets with a muted scrape. Ria came last, twin daggers held low, wrists loose.
Kiryssa's eyes moved over them once.
"Good. You're already practiced combatants, that I can tell."
None of them answered.
"Against conventional opponents, that is."
Kiryssa stepped forward.
She vanished.

Iris felt it before she saw it. Pressure slammed into her chest, enough to rattle breath and spike sensation. She staggered back two steps, teeth clenched, every nerve screaming detail into her awareness. Pain mapped itself cleanly across her body, sharp and precise, feeding her rather than slowing her thanks to her Child of Reckoning class.
Blossom reacted on instinct. She lunged with her claws sweeping where Kiryssa had been.
Nothing.
Ria was already moving, daggers crossing to intercept the angle Blossom left open. She felt air split near her neck and twisted, only to find nothing in her reach.
Kiryssa reappeared behind them, nonchalant as ever. She lifted her fingers that were glowing with magic. Upon her doing so, three marks appeared on the necks of the trio, one for each.
"If I were to flick my fingers, three heads would hit the ground in the next moment," she decreed.
Then, seeing their shock and confusion, the drow primordial smiled and lowered her fingers. "And that was the slow version."
"No way..." Ria gasped.
"Lady Kiryssa is so badass!!" Blossom decreed with a wagging tail, eliciting a minor chuckle from the woman.
Iris then began grumbling, "The level gap is too big..."

"Young lady, looking for excuses so soon is the mark of a weakling," Kiryssa smiled, then doubled down when she saw the sour expression on Iris's face. "I was only using the speed I had back when I was your level."
"Ugh...! It's been billions of years, are you sure you remember correctly?"
"... Young lady. Watch your words." "Hehe! What a sore loser!" Ria giggled at her friend.
"Iris is a loser!!" Blossom added fuel to the fire.
The raven-haired woman's forehead suddenly sported numerous throbbing veins and her grip on her sword tightened tenfold.
Kiryssa laughed one final time, then jumped into action for the second time.
The following exchange was worse than the last.

Kiryssa did not vanish this time. She moved just fast enough to be seen, which somehow made it harder to track her. Iris took the first hit again, a flat strike to the ribs that folded her inward before she could turn it. Pain tore through her frame in clean layers. She rode it, feet skidding, vision narrowing into sharp lines instead of blur.
When she swung, she hit nothing.

Blossom tried to capitalize on the opening. She cut in low, claws snapping for tendons. Kiryssa stepped inside the arc, shoulder-checking Blossom mid-lunge and twisting her balance sideways. Blossom hit the ground hard and rolled, instantly getting up. But it was too late.

Ria never stopped moving. She circled, blades testing angles that did not exist yet. Kiryssa let her think she had one. The counter came so fast, Ria barely registered the touch before her dagger was slapped out of her hand and embedded hilt-deep in the dirt.
They regrouped without words.

Again and again, Kiryssa broke their rhythm. She slipped between attacks, turned momentum against them, punished hesitation, and punished certainty even harder. When they collapsed, she waited. When they stood, she struck.
After one particularly brutal exchange, she finally stepped back and gestured with two fingers. "Breathe and discuss among yourselves strategies to overcome me. We will continue in ten minutes."
Not far away, Thyra had taken Felicity and Feng to an entirely different stretch of ground.

At first, the two teens and their gazes were locked onto the pink dome and the fierce duel about to unfold inside. However, they were quickly forbidden from looking by multiple of Quinlan's wives, and Serika went as far as to ask Thyra if she could train them herself, saying she believed the mother of humanity would be a great teacher.

Thyra offered no rebuttals and took the job, which also meant she grabbed Felicity and Feng by the back of their collars and began dragging them toward a clearing further away from the pink-tinted dome. The two teenagers dug their heels into the dirt and kept their eyes fixed on the pulsating light behind them. They looked like young cats being pulled away from a bird.

"It's not fair!" Feng shouted at Serika while trying to twist out of Thyra's grip. "You let us fight in the wars, and you let us see humans get ripped apart, but suddenly we aren't allowed to watch Quinlan's duel? That's a battlefield in there, and Quinlan is fighting for his soul. We should be studying his defensive maneuvers and his endurance under extreme pressure..."

Felicity nodded and folded her arms over her chest. "I am worried about his mana circulation and his heart rate. Plus, I have a duty to learn some of those moves. Nyxara is an ancient master and it would be a disservice to my future as a woman if I didn't take notes on her technique. It is strictly for academic purposes and my personal development. Deny me now, I dare you."
"Sure. Denied." All women said together, making Felicity gasp strongly, unable to believe her flawless logic was brushed aside so easily.
"Nice try, young ones," Thyra said and kept walking until the dome was obscured by the trees. "Now, instead of letting those two corrupt your minds, let us get to work."

"B-but Miss Thyra, aren't we right?" Feng asked, refusing to give up so easily. "We're fighting life-or-death battles where we see extreme cruelty on full display at all times. I've killed many men and women with my two hands! Felicity is the same. Why is us seeing people have sex so much worse?"

Thyra smiled and placed a warm hand on the head of each girl as they looked at her with pleading puppy eyes. She stopped walking and turned to face them fully while her expression softened into a truly motherly look.

"Your curiosity is understandable, and it is natural for teenagers to wonder about these things. If you want an education on love and relationships, I can provide that for you as well as combat training."
"Then why can't we just watch them?" Felicity asked.

"Because the scene in that dome is not for the minds of youngsters like you. If that becomes your exposure to intimacy before you experience it yourself, your perception of love will be forever warped. Nyxara is a sadistic demon of lust. You, young human women, should not treat her as someone to imitate. Furthermore, Quinlan is not behaving like a man should when being with a woman he loves because he is fighting for his dear life with all he has. Watching them would only corrupt your mind and make you think that making love is a brutal battle when it is one of the most beautiful aspects of life. That is not something I, or anyone else, wants for either of you."
Both girls looked surprised, and their arguments died away as they processed her words. Feng looked up at Thyra with a curious expression. "Were you a 'player' too back in the day, Miss Thyra?"
