chapters.title: Chapter 1437 Big Sis
paragraphs: Thyra smiled softly and shook her head. "I was much more interested in becoming a strong fighter than anything else. However, I did have a few families of my own over the years, so I can provide you with all the information you need on how proper relationships should work."
"Okay!" both teens shouted together with big smiles on their faces, then sat down expectantly.

Thyra raised an eyebrow and looked at their happy expressions with a hint of amusement. "Why do you look like I am just going to start telling you stories now? You will train until you are exhausted beyond belief. If you have earned it through your hard work, I might share some tidbits with you while you rest."
"What?!" both girls yelled and pouted at the same time.
Thyra ignored their dramatic sighs. There were no spells or weapons present at this training station, only posture and footwork.
A back-to-the-basics training, setting up perfect foundations for the future.
"You both skipped some steps," Thyra said, circling them. "I can see it clearly."
Felicity crossed her arms. "We can handle ourselves. We even went on a long adventure without Quinlan's protection!"

Feng then gingerly added, "Well, we thought we didn't have his protection... But Felicity is right about one thing! We have very powerful classes, I think we should learn how to use those to the utmost."

"You might be able to survive on an adventure, but not thrive in a life-or-death situation. Isn't that right? If you want to become a woman who can shoulder the weight of being the one who protects instead of being protected, then you better listen."
"Ouch!" Felicity yelped, feeling called out.
"Miss Thyra is so kind, but she can spit some painful truths so nonchalantly too..." Feng grumbled.
Lucille found Dragnar.
The Primordial Dread stood near the stone rise with his arms folded, observing Quinlan's duel while shaking his head. Lucille walked up to him.
"Can you teach me how to become the dread of war, Dragnar?" she asked, taking the direct approach instead of what many would in her situation.
Hanae, a short distance away, pouted playfully. After all, Lucille asked to study under her previously. She was changing mentors just like this... What a traitor!

But the Bloodmonger only giggled in response. "Lady Hanae, you were the first to offer, that's why I jumped at your offer. I didn't know we could pick and choose from multiple primordials as teachers... If I did, I might've gone with Lady Thyra instead."
Hanae stared at her for a heartbeat, pretending to be hurt out of nothing more than playfulness, then sighed. "You truly are a berserker at heart, despite your gentle-looking appearance."
Lucille grinned, unapologetic.

Hanae shook her head, then smiled despite herself. She was only playing, after all, enjoying having such small, nonconsequential exchanges with mortals for the first time in millions of years. "It is the right choice. Any berserker should learn from Dragnar."
Dragnar looked down at Lucille. "It won't be easy."
"I wouldn't have it any other way!" Lucille decreed with excitement.

Training under Dragnar was not torture as one might expect. The Primordial Dread didn't turn Lucille into mincemeat and expect her to learn from the experience. Instead, what he gave her was pressure. He forced Lucille to manage her escalation, to recognize the point where hunger overtook judgment. He baited her into overextension, punished it once, then waited to see if she learned.
By the end of the first hour, Lucille was breathing hard and her axe was heavier than it had been before.
She was smiling anyway.
She found one amazing teacher.
It was time to make the most of it.
Hanae gathered Ayame and Black Fang with a small wave of her hand and led them away from the others, toward a quieter section of the clearing where the ground was even and clear.
She stopped and turned to face them, eyes moving between the two young women with open interest.

"My genes are truly superb," Hanae decreed proudly after a bit, nodding to herself as if confirming a long-held theory. "I already knew it, but it's good to see they didn't lose effectiveness even after so long."
Ayame blinked once, then giggled. "For an ancient lady, you are surprisingly playful."

Hanae's lips curved upward. "Is it a crime for someone like me to be happy, child? My heart is brimming with joy. I can't believe I finally get to interact with mortals after so long... Today is a day I'll celebrate for many years to come."
"No, it's not a crime," Ayame replied with an even bigger smile forming on her delicate lips. "If anything, I hope I will still have just as much joy as you do when I reach your age."
Black Fang inclined her head. "Many lose themselves to time."
Ayame glanced at her. "Are you talking about Yoruha, or the skellies?"
"All of them have numerous problems."

Ayame opened her mouth, clearly ready with something sharp, something the Venomborne Terror wouldn't like. She understood it too, because Black Fang's eyes flicked toward her. The look carried weight. Ayame laughed and raised her hands in surrender.
"Okay, okay. I'll try to be respectful to my big sis. Damn... It's still so weird to call you that..."
"Big sis?" Hanae chirped, eyes lighting up with newfound excitement, looking an awful lot like a schoolgirl sniffing the newest gossip. "I knew I felt something familiar about you two! Tell me more."

Ayame scratched the back of her head. "Seems my bastard of a father sired Black Fang and then ruined her life to save face. Or something horribly cruel like that. I'll sort it out eventually. After I get stronger."
Black Fang exhaled slowly, then shifted her attention back to Hanae. "Speaking of strength. Lady-"
"Please," Hanae interjected gently. "Call me Hanae."

Black Fang nodded. "Hanae. There is a young woman named Kaede. She is Ayame's younger sister, someone who should not be a noteworthy combatant. Instead, she rose almost overnight and now matches me in strength."
Ayame's expression sharpened when the topic of her younger sister was brought up. The mystery that had been eating away at her mind, giving her multiple sleepless nights as she pondered in bed.
"We suspect that her blade is empowering her," Black Fang continued. "Do you know of such a phenomenon?"
Hanae blinked. "It's one thing for a blade to empower its wielder, but that much? This does not sound like anything from my time. Tell me more."
Ayame nodded. "Sure. It started when..."

The explanation went on for a good few minutes, making the eastern primordial's gaze darken multiple times. When she learned of the horrible betrayal both girls experienced, she looked ready to cause extreme bloodshed among the members of her bloodline.
As for the sword, she didn't know what it could be in particular, saying it was best to ask Björn. But that could come later. Hanae gestured for them to take their stances.
"Enough talking. Let me see how my descendants move."

And just like this, fights and training sessions broke out all around Quinlan's dome. As the man fought with all he had, so did his girls and allies do their utmost to become a better version of themselves.
Quinlan, meanwhile, was making progress with his own fight.
It was time to evolve even further!

He forced Lucille to manage her escalation, to recognize the point where hunger overtook judgment.
He baited her into overextension, punished it once, then waited to see if she learned.
By the end of the first hour, Lucille was breathing hard and her axe was heavier than it had been before.
She was smiling anyway.
She found one amazing teacher.
It was time to make the most of it.
Hanae gathered Ayame and Black Fang with a small wave of her hand and led them away from the others, toward a quieter section of the clearing where the ground was even and clear.
She stopped and turned to face them, eyes moving between the two young women with open interest.
"My genes are truly superb," Hanae decreed proudly after a bit, nodding to herself as if confirming a long-held theory.
"I already knew it, but it's good to see they didn't lose effectiveness even after so long."
Ayame blinked once, then giggled.
"For an ancient lady, you are surprisingly playful."
Hanae's lips curved upward.
"Is it a crime for someone like me to be happy, child?
My heart is brimming with joy.
I can't believe I finally get to interact with mortals after so long...
Today is a day I'll celebrate for many years to come."
"No, it's not a crime," Ayame replied with an even bigger smile forming on her delicate lips.
"If anything, I hope I will still have just as much joy as you do when I reach your age."
Black Fang inclined her head.
"Many lose themselves to time."
Ayame glanced at her.
"Are you talking about Yoruha, or the skellies?"
"All of them have numerous problems."
Ayame opened her mouth, clearly ready with something sharp, something the Venomborne Terror wouldn't like.
She understood it too, because Black Fang's eyes flicked toward her.
The look carried weight.
Ayame laughed and raised her hands in surrender.
"Okay, okay.
I'll try to be respectful to my big sis.
Damn...
It's still so weird to call you that..."
"Big sis?" Hanae chirped, eyes lighting up with newfound excitement, looking an awful lot like a schoolgirl sniffing the newest gossip.
"I knew I felt something familiar about you two!
Tell me more."
Ayame scratched the back of her head.
"Seems my bastard of a father sired Black Fang and then ruined her life to save face.
Or something horribly cruel like that.
I'll sort it out eventually.
After I get stronger."
Black Fang exhaled slowly, then shifted her attention back to Hanae.
"Speaking of strength.
Lady-"
"Please," Hanae interjected gently.
"Call me Hanae."
Black Fang nodded.
"Hanae.
There is a young woman named Kaede.
She is Ayame's younger sister, someone who should not be a noteworthy combatant.
Instead, she rose almost overnight and now matches me in strength."
Ayame's expression sharpened when the topic of her younger sister was brought up.
The mystery that had been eating away at her mind, giving her multiple sleepless nights as she pondered in bed.
"We suspect that her blade is empowering her," Black Fang continued.
"Do you know of such a phenomenon?"
Hanae blinked.
"It's one thing for a blade to empower its wielder, but that much?
This does not sound like anything from my time.
Tell me more."
Ayame nodded.
"Sure.
It started when..."
The explanation went on for a good few minutes, making the eastern primordial's gaze darken multiple times.
When she learned of the horrible betrayal both girls experienced, she looked ready to cause extreme bloodshed among the members of her bloodline.
As for the sword, she didn't know what it could be in particular, saying it was best to ask Björn.
But that could come later.
Hanae gestured for them to take their stances.
"Enough talking.
Let me see how my descendants move."
And just like this, fights and training sessions broke out all around Quinlan's dome.
As the man fought with all he had, so did his girls and allies do their utmost to become a better version of themselves.
Quinlan, meanwhile, was making progress with his own fight.
It was time to evolve even further!

chapters.title: Chapter 1438 Lesson From the Primordial Samurai
paragraphs: Hanae stood relaxed for the time being with her feet set and hands resting near the hilt, watching Ayame and Black Fang settle into position. Her gaze carried approval rather than concern, waiting for them to make their moves.
Ayame moved first.

She closed the distance fast, using her Skysplitter class to the maximum as she cut upward in a clean diagonal meant to test timing. Black Fang did not mirror her. She disappeared sideways instead, with her body folding into motion as her curved blade aimed for Hanae's flank.
Hanae stepped between both attacks.
Steel met air.

She turned Ayame's strike aside with a small rotation of her wrist and slid past Black Fang's blade with a half step that placed her just outside killing range. Her sword never fully left its sheath. The movement alone forced both women to adjust.
They pressed harder.

Ayame layered her attacks, forcing Hanae to move backward for the first time. Her cuts flowed into each other without pause, vertical into horizontal, forcing space. Black Fang used that space immediately, slipping in behind Hanae's shoulder, blade angled for the neck.
Hanae drew.
The sound was soft. Almost polite.
She pivoted and struck once.

Black Fang twisted away at the last moment, her robe tearing where the edge passed. She landed light, already moving again. Her eyes were sharp, and her expression focused. She did not slow, for this was not the first rodeo of this professional murderer.

She'd been at this job for four centuries now, started before she learned how to even speak properly. Her reflexes were honed to the utmost, and she was a great tactician as well when it came to personal combat, evidencing how she used Ayame's attacks to make strikes of her own.

Despite being much stronger than the Skysplitter, Black Fang had no ego that demanded she take center stage. She was more than happy to let Ayame play the main character while she remained out of focus.
She knew that the primordial samurai held an immense upper hand even in a two-versus-one fight; thus, using a distraction - her half-sister - to land a critical blow was her best bet.
Hanae shifted, straight into Ayame.

Her pressure snapped forward, blade finally freed of its scabbard as she drove Ayame back step by step. The cuts came tight and close, never wide, never greedy. Ayame met them head-on, katana flashing in fast deflections, wrists burning as each impact carried weight that should not have been there based on her past experiences.
Hanae did not slow.

She crowded Ayame's guard, shoulder nearly brushing chest, blade striking from angles that forced Ayame to give ground. One misstep. Another. Ayame gritted her teeth and held on to the best of her ability.
Behind Hanae, space folded.
Black Fang struck.
Her blade came in low and silent, aimed for the spine. Hanae did not turn.
Steel rang behind her back.
Hanae caught the strike with the flat of her blade without looking. At the same time, her heel drove forward.
The kick landed clean into Ayame's stomach.

Air left Ayame in a sharp burst as her body lifted and flew, tumbling across the primordial village before sliding to a stop a long distance away. Her katana clattered and stuck point-first into the ground beside her.
Hanae turned.
The warmth was gone from her face.
Black Fang's instincts howled at her. This woman was danger itself, its personification. Her stance widened on its own as Hanae's eyes settled on her and nowhere else.
"A big sister," Hanae muttered, "who would trade her little sister's life for an opening."
Black Fang stepped back once and set her feet. "I didn't come here for lectures in morality."
Hanae's mouth curved.
Not kindly.
"Good. That's the mindset one needs to survive your way of life for as long as you have, Miss Venomborne."
Hanae's cruel smile deepened as she decreed, "Great sacrifice is required when faced with an insurmountable enemy."
Black Fang's jaw tightened. She hated how Hanae spoke as if there was simply no chance of victory in this battle.
She lifted her blade, and venom traced patterns along its edge, dark and alive. "Enough talking. Let's kill each other."
A sharp grin emerged on Black Fang's delicate features. She was not alone.
The two women stared each other down with extreme cruelty showing in their gazes, making it clear that, despite her laid-back attitude, Hanae used to be a fierce warrior.
She giggled, light and wrong, her expression darkening into pure sadism. "As you wish."
Black Fang moved first.
Venom surged through her limbs, speed snapping her forward in a blur meant to end the fight in one motion.
Hanae was already there.
There was no chant. No spell spoken. Just a step that crossed too much distance and a single cut that passed through Black Fang's neck as if nothing resisted it.
Her head left her shoulders cleanly, with blood trailing after it.
Hanae caught it midair with one hand and lifted it to her face.
She looked into Black Fang's widening eyes and smiled. "Sweet dreams, child."
The world reset. Or to be more accurate, her body regenerated almost instantly, as was the nature of the primordial dimension.
Black Fang gasped.

She dropped to one knee with her hand flying to her neck and fingers digging into skin that was whole again. Her breath came fast as the sensation caught up to her. The ground beneath her felt cold. Death.
True death.
That's what happened to her.
Her body had returned. Her strength had returned.
What had not returned was the certainty that had followed her for centuries.
Four hundred years of surviving that plane of cruel existence... It all ended in one motion.
No struggle. No contest. One step. One cut.
While Black Fang took a moment to gather herself, a fight was already underway.
Ayame rushed Hanae with her katana raised. The attack was direct. Hanae met it without surprise.
Steel clashed once. Then again. Ayame pressed hard, teeth bared, refusing to give space even as each exchange drove her backward.
Hanae turned her blade and knocked Ayame's katana aside. She stepped in close, so close Ayame had to tilt her head back to keep sight of her.
"You are weaker than her," Hanae said, voice level. "By a wide margin. So why are you the one charging me? Are you intent on playing the role of the suicidal hero?"
Ayame swung anyway.
Hanae caught the strike and pushed. Ayame stumbled. A foot hooked behind her ankle, and the world flipped.
Ayame hit the ground on her back with a grunt. Hanae's katana stopped a finger's width from her chest, aimed straight for the heart.
"Why do you fight with reckless abandon?" Hanae asked.
Ayame clenched her fists. "Get it over with."

Hanae tilted her head. "Is it because you believe you must? Second in command of the Primordial Villain. The young girl who steps forward when the mighty leader cannot. Those are tough boots to fill, child... And you know that better than anyone else. Now that Quinlan fights his own battle, you believe it falls to you to stand taller than you can reach."
The blade did not waver.
"It is admirable, and foolish."
Ayame's breathing was rough. Her gaze stayed fixed on the steel above her. She did not look away.
"Honor and creed," Hanae said. "Those words shaped my youth as well. They are useful guides. But tell me this. Is it worth discarding your life for them?"

Ayame swallowed. "Is this something the primordial samurai should be saying...?" She remembered her Fujimori upbringing, of the many values hammered into her to become the next clan leader. Her demigod ancestor was contradicting them right now.

Hanae's gaze didn't soften. "I am who I am. I think what I think. There's a time and place for honorable deaths, but it should come when all other avenues have been eliminated... Not you trying to outshine a much stronger ally and folding under a burden you simply had no business carrying on your back."
Her grip loosened around the hilt of her katana. Memories pressed in, voices from another time, lessons carved into her before she had known better ways existed.
The pressure lifted.
Hanae withdrew her blade and rose in one smooth motion. She sheathed it and straightened, the sharpness draining from her presence as if it had never been there.
Then she clapped her hands together, bright and delighted. "Oh, you two are wonderful! Truly promising students. I cannot wait to see what you become."
Ayame pushed herself up slowly and shot her a narrow look. "Great..." she muttered. "The happy granny is back. Guess the demoness from a moment ago went for a walk."
"No, the demoness is busy draining your lover's life essence," Black Fang let out a low breath and stood.

chapters.title: Chapter 1439 Stop Bickering
paragraphs: "No, the demoness is busy draining your lover's life essence," Black Fang let out a low breath and stood. "This is no demoness but a warrior who's extinguished more lives than I can even imagine..."
"H-hey!" Ayame gasped, unable to believe this woman would make such a joke.
Well... She sent a gaze toward the dome and had to begrudgingly accept that it wasn't exactly a false statement.
Hanae beamed at the pair as if she had not just brutally folded them moments ago.
She turned, crossed a few steps, and lowered herself to the ground with grace, legs folding beneath her into a calm seated posture.
"Sit. Both of you."
Ayame blinked. Black Fang frowned.
"We are ready to continue," they said at the same time.
Hanae did not open her eyes. "Later."
Ayame clicked her tongue. "We barely got started."

"You got finished," Hanae replied. "Training without thought is how you work relentlessly and remain mediocre all your life. Training with reflection is how every great warrior of every era was shaped."
Neither of them moved.
"If you do not examine where you failed," Hanae continued, "you will repeat the same mistakes with greater confidence and die faster for it."

Ayame folded her arms. Black Fang's reluctance was clear to all. Hanae opened one eye and glanced at them. "I am the master here. Why do my two terribly young students refuse to listen to the wise one?"
That did it.
With visible reluctance, they sat. Ayame dropped down a little too hard, clearly eager to go for a second round.
She then leaned sideways and flashed a smug grin at Black Fang. "So how does it feel to finally be called young?"
Black Fang turned her head just enough. "... Weak one, you seem to forget your place in the pecking order."
There was a sharp crack.
Both of them pitched forward and faceplanted into the ground.
"Ouch!" Ayame groaned while lifting her head. "What was that for, granny?!"
Hanae's hand was already back on her knee. "You will stop taunting your big sister. She is far stronger than you. If you keep provoking her, she will teach you some very real life lessons."
Ayame muttered something into the ground.
Black Fang lifted her head slowly and fixed Hanae with a narrow stare. She did not speak. The question was clear enough. 'Why did I get smacked, too?!'
Hanae met her gaze. "And you will stop bullying your little sister. Power makes right, yes, but it does not decide conduct within the family. Cherish your sibling."
Black Fang's eyes held for a moment longer. Then she looked away with a quiet huff.
Both Fujimori sisters grumbled under their breaths and exchanged a glance that carried a great number of unsaid words.
"Khm!" Hanae cleared her throat.
Reluctantly, they straightened and settled into place. The noise faded. Breathing slowed. The stone beneath them cooled.
"Now," Hanae began while closing her eyes again. "Think. Remember. Analyze."
Neither answered.
But this time, neither tried to speak back.
Kaelira wiped her brow with the back of her forearm and set the piece down on the anvil.
Metal ticked as it cooled.
Björn leaned over it, thick arms crossed, beard braided. He turned the piece once with a pair of tongs, gave it a look, then another.
"Passable," he said.
Ever the perfectionist when it came to the art of smithing, Kaelira's jaw tightened, hating that remark.
She did not answer. She reached for the next ingot instead, slid it into the forge, and began again.
Heat rolled over her in waves. Sparks jumped. Her shoulders ached, forearms screaming with every strike. When she finally quenched the second piece and presented it, Björn gave the same look.
"Passable."
Her grip around the hammer creaked.

Hours bled together. Then days. The smithy near Quinlan's dome never cooled, never slept. Kaelira's hands blistered and healed and blistered again. Every time Björn demonstrated a motion, the timing was exact. The pressure perfect. When she tried to mirror it, something was always off by a hair.
Too much force. Not enough. Angle wrong by a fraction.
"Passable."
By the time the word came again, sweat ran down her spine, and her hair clung to her face. She slammed the hammer down onto the anvil harder than necessary.
Björn did not react.
Kaelira sucked in a breath and forced herself to speak. "Do you think I'll ever be able to make a Mythical-grade piece?"
Björn shrugged. "Who knows."
That answer stung worse than any critique.
Kaelira hesitated, then said it anyway. "Is it because I'm an elf?"
Björn's head snapped toward her.
The forge roared between them, but his stare cut clean through it. "Insecurity has no place in my smithy."
Kaelira froze. Then she exhaled slowly, realizing how sharp her words had been. Frustration had gotten ahead of her.

Björn turned back to the forge. "You grew up in a world where dwarves are spoken of as if we were born with hammers in our hands. As if we have some hidden trait that raises the quality of whatever we touch."
He snorted. "Do you think those bastards who popped out of my balls have some mystical '1 grade higher outcome' skill or something?"

He reached into the forge and adjusted the metal. "No. We are born stubborn. We tolerate heat. We tolerate weight. We tolerate days without sunlight. We take pride in making something real with our hands."
He glanced back at her. "That is why dwarves make good smiths. Not because others cannot. But because most do not want it badly enough."
Kaelira lowered her head. "I'm sorry. I got heated and said something I shouldn't have."

Björn's mouth curved into a grin. "Getting heated is exactly the mark of a good craftsman. There's nothing to apologize for, lass. Instead of pretending to be calm like the rest of you leaf munchers, you want to be better. You want perfection. I can work with that."
Kaelira smiled despite herself.
Björn was quiet for a moment. Then he said, "As for your question of Mythic Grade, I have never seen a mortal create one."
"But," he added, "haven't you already made something truly admirable?"
Kaelira blinked. "What?"
"The armor on the primordial boy. You made it. Part of it, at least."
Her eyes widened. "How did you know?"
Björn stroked his beard. "That armor is unique. It responds to you. Drawn to you like a child to its mother."

Kaelira let out a slow breath, feeling her shock recede. This man was truly Thalorind's greatest smith; his intuition was far too potent. "It's an Anima armor... Or, rather, I should say it's a she, Synchra. We... Or rather, Quinlan decided that she was a girl, and the armor approved instantly. Synchra was created by Quinlan and me with help from someone very unique. A teacher from a closed-off world... His strange class made it possible."
Björn hummed. "Anima armor," he repeated. "That explains a few things."
Kaelira opened her mouth to ask more.
But just then, the dome flared.
Pink light surged, thick and violent. The forge flickered. Tools vibrated where they hung.
Kaelira's heart lurched. The tomboy elf was worried for her boyfriend's well-being. She spun and rushed to the window.
What welcomed her eyes made her heart skip a beat.
The energy pouring from the dome twisted, deepened, changed.
Quinlan was evolving.
Author: Tomorrow, it'll end.

Breathing slowed.
The stone beneath them cooled.
"Now," Hanae began while closing her eyes again.
"Think.
Remember.
Analyze."
Neither answered.
But this time, neither tried to speak back.
Kaelira wiped her brow with the back of her forearm and set the piece down on the anvil.
Metal ticked as it cooled.
Björn leaned over it, thick arms crossed, beard braided.
He turned the piece once with a pair of tongs, gave it a look, then another.
"Passable," he said.
Ever the perfectionist when it came to the art of smithing, Kaelira's jaw tightened, hating that remark.
She did not answer.
She reached for the next ingot instead, slid it into the forge, and began again.
Heat rolled over her in waves.
Sparks jumped.
Her shoulders ached, forearms screaming with every strike.
When she finally quenched the second piece and presented it, Björn gave the same look.
"Passable."
Her grip around the hammer creaked.
Hours bled together.
Then days.
The smithy near Quinlan's dome never cooled, never slept.
Kaelira's hands blistered and healed and blistered again.
Every time Björn demonstrated a motion, the timing was exact.
The pressure perfect.
When she tried to mirror it, something was always off by a hair.
Too much force.
Not enough.
Angle wrong by a fraction.
"Passable."
By the time the word came again, sweat ran down her spine, and her hair clung to her face.
She slammed the hammer down onto the anvil harder than necessary.
Björn did not react.
Kaelira sucked in a breath and forced herself to speak.
"Do you think I'll ever be able to make a Mythical-grade piece?"
Björn shrugged.
"Who knows."
That answer stung worse than any critique.
Kaelira hesitated, then said it anyway.
"Is it because I'm an elf?"
Björn's head snapped toward her.
The forge roared between them, but his stare cut clean through it.
"Insecurity has no place in my smithy."
Kaelira froze.
Then she exhaled slowly, realizing how sharp her words had been.
Frustration had gotten ahead of her.
Björn turned back to the forge.
"You grew up in a world where dwarves are spoken of as if we were born with hammers in our hands.
As if we have some hidden trait that raises the quality of whatever we touch."
He snorted.
"Do you think those bastards who popped out of my balls have some mystical '1 grade higher outcome' skill or something?"
He reached into the forge and adjusted the metal.
"No.
We are born stubborn.
We tolerate heat.
We tolerate weight.
We tolerate days without sunlight.
We take pride in making something real with our hands."
He glanced back at her.
"That is why dwarves make good smiths.
Not because others cannot.
But because most do not want it badly enough."
Kaelira lowered her head.
"I'm sorry.
I got heated and said something I shouldn't have."
Björn's mouth curved into a grin.
"Getting heated is exactly the mark of a good craftsman.
There's nothing to apologize for, lass.
Instead of pretending to be calm like the rest of you leaf munchers, you want to be better.
You want perfection.
I can work with that."
Kaelira smiled despite herself.
Björn was quiet for a moment.
Then he said, "As for your question of Mythic Grade, I have never seen a mortal create one."
"But," he added, "haven't you already made something truly admirable?"
Kaelira blinked.
"What?"
"The armor on the primordial boy.
You made it.
Part of it, at least."
Her eyes widened.
"How did you know?"
Björn stroked his beard.
"That armor is unique.
It responds to you.
Drawn to you like a child to its mother."
Kaelira let out a slow breath, feeling her shock recede.
This man was truly Thalorind's greatest smith; his intuition was far too potent.
"It's an Anima armor...
Or, rather, I should say it's a she, Synchra.
We...
Or rather, Quinlan decided that she was a girl, and the armor approved instantly.
Synchra was created by Quinlan and me with help from someone very unique.
A teacher from a closed-off world...
His strange class made it possible."
Björn hummed.
"Anima armor," he repeated.
"That explains a few things."
Kaelira opened her mouth to ask more.
But just then, the dome flared.
Pink light surged, thick and violent.
The forge flickered.
Tools vibrated where they hung.
Kaelira's heart lurched.
The tomboy elf was worried for her boyfriend's well-being.
She spun and rushed to the window.
What welcomed her eyes made her heart skip a beat.
The energy pouring from the dome twisted, deepened, changed.
Quinlan was evolving.
Author: Tomorrow, it'll end.

chapters.title: Chapter 1440 No Longer One Sided
paragraphs: The days passed by quickly while the atmosphere inside remained a constant storm of rose-colored mist. Quinlan lost track of the hours as the trial pushed him beyond the limits of primordial endurance. He fell into a rhythm of repeated failure and recovery that would have broken the sanity of a lesser man.

Whenever his concentration slipped, and he lost his seed to her relentless grip, Nyxara would cradle his head to her bosom with affection. She whispered that he was a brave warrior and that he could do even more. She told him that his resistance was the most delicious spice she had ever tasted and urged him to try again so she could savor him more. Quinlan did not react to her taunts with anger or frustration. He swallowed his arrogance and viewed her mockery as a tactical opening. While she was busy enjoying the situation and elongating the trial for her benefit, he sank into his internal world and accelerated his mana intake. The flickering spark of energy he had first felt grew into a steady stream that flowed through his body even as he moved. He stopped trying to find a quiet place in his mind and instead accepted the chaos as his natural environment.
By the end of the seventh day, he had achieved a state of functional stability within the confines of the bed. By the end of the fourteenth, he felt confident in maintaining his concentration.

He learned to synchronize his breathing with the heavy thuds of his heart and the frantic shrieks of the woman beneath him. The noise of the dome was no longer a distraction but a steady beat that he used to anchor his focus. Nyxara's eyes never lost their playful light as the days progressed, even as the duel stopped being so incredibly one-sided. She found that she had to work much, much harder to disrupt his focus, and her own breathing was becoming hitched. She realized that her prey was no longer just surviving but was actively using her as a whetstone to sharpen his own skills. Yet despite those realizations, the Primordial Demon of Lust never went for the finishing strike. Such was her gluttony. The more Quinlan resisted, the more her infatuation grew, the less she felt the desire to end it all.

Quinlan, despite getting better, never allowed himself to relax because he knew that simply staying in the fight was not victory. Furthermore, he understood that this was not a mage battle where a fireball could end the struggle. The trial was about conquering Nyxara sexually, not killing her. That's why the mana he regenerated was nothing more than fuel to be burned within his own marrow to reinforce his muscles and organs, using the four basic elements he had access to. He was using the energy to turn his body into an unbreakable engine of carnal output.
But he needed more.

Quinlan drove into her with a heavy and relentless rhythm that made the entire bed frame groan under their combined weight. Nyxara's head thrashed against the sweat-soaked pillows while her perky breasts bounced with a frantic rhythm. She bit her lower lip until a bead of dark blood appeared, and her hands gripped the muscles of his back with enough force to leave permanent marks. She was no longer purring incessantly but was instead gasping for air between her own sounds of pleasure.

"You're incredible!❤️" she managed to moan as she arched her back to meet every strike. "No man should be able to do this. At this rate, I'm going to be so infatuated that I'll never let you go, Little Ruin... I'll keep you in my arms for a thousand years so that I can feel you inside me like this every passing moment❤️"

"Ngghhn!" She let out a high-pitched cry as her internal muscles clamped down on him with a new level of desperation. She looked at him with eyes that were violently throbbing with the shape of luminescent hearts. Then, she parted her lips to continue her ecstatic ramblings.

Quinlan did not let her. He reached out and pressed his palm firmly over her mouth, pinning her head back against the mattress. His gaze was cold and heavy as he looked down at the demoness who was trying to claim his future.
"You've said enough, demon," Quinlan declared with a voice that was a low and dangerous rumble. "Now shut your mouth."

The physical act of silencing her, combined with his absolute dominance, triggered an immediate and violent reaction from her body. Nyxara's heart-shaped pupils dilated until they almost swallowed the pink iris, and her entire frame shuddered. A massive surge of iridescent nectar gushed from her core and coated his manhood, making the sound of their wild humping turn into a wet and rhythmic splashing.
The increased lubrication allowed Quinlan to increase his speed to a level that was previously impossible. Quinlan looked directly into Nyxara's wide, throbbing eyes and announced,
"I'll go all out."

He reached for his pocket ring mentally and pulled. The Soul Reaper saber materialized in the air, hovering just next to Nyxara's neck. The dark metal of the blade pulsed with a cold, hungry light. Nyxara's eyes tracked the edge of the blade, her pupils expanding until the pink hearts practically glowed against Quinlan's slick skin. She let out a tremulous moan and arched her neck toward the steel.
Quinlan let out a dark chuckle. "How down bad do you have to be to get excited at the idea of getting beheaded? You damned freak."

With her mouth still not permitted to open due to his firm hold on her lips, Nyxara could only moan in response, full of need and excitement. "❤️❤️❤️" "[Awaken]." Quinlan commanded, ignoring the freak beneath him.

A burst of blue flames erupted from the saber. Scar materialized. The blue-skinned woman landed on the edge of the mattress with her twin daggers already drawn. She took one look at the scene, the sweat-slicked bodies, the wet splashing of Quinlan's manhood against the succubus' folds, and the fanatical expression on the woman in question...
And her posture immediately stiffened.
She looked at Quinlan with a mixture of confusion and horror visible behind her mask.
"Master..." Scar whispered. "Did you really summon me to... help you claim victory here?"
Quinlan didn't slow his pace. He drove into Nyxara with a heavy, grounding thud that made the succubus shriek into his hand. "Exactly."

Scar looked from the bed to her own daggers, her grip tightening until her knuckles turned a darker shade of blue. "Master... I am not good at this. I don't know what you assume about my past as a human female, but... My skills are for the silent kill. I do not know how to... participate in carnal warfare."

"You aren't participating like that. This is my war to fight," Quinlan grunted with his muscles rippling as he adjusted his grip on Nyxara's neck. "You're going to act as my conduit. I'm going to try something new, and I need a stable soul to anchor the energy."
Scar's blue skin visibly darkened into a small blush. She looked down at where the two were joined, then back at Quinlan's face. "Oh... Whatever you need, Master..."
"Come closer."

Scar knelt on the silk mattress next to Quinlan's head. She closed her eyes and placed her blue hands on his back. Quinlan felt the connection form immediately as his aura expanded. The blue flames from the saber began to lick at his skin without burning him. His Primordial Breeding Physique flared, as it always had. It's been the sole reason Quinlan lasted for so many days - the real MVP of the fight. Without his physique, none of this would've happened. Quinlan would've been slurped up by the demon ages ago.
But using his resistant physique and his mana regeneration got him this far. Now, he felt ready for the next step.
Quinlan kept his palm pressed over Nyxara's mouth and maintained his heavy rhythm even as he pulled his consciousness deep into his own soul realm.

He bypassed the physical sensations of the succubus and the wet sounds of their struggle. He found himself in the familiar clearing of his mind where the fairy tree stood. The two concept seeds hung from the branches like dangerous fruit. Mimi was perched on a low limb, and she jumped to her feet when she sensed his presence. She looked at the ripples of energy vibrating through the roots of her tree.
"Scary Uncle!" she chirped while she smoothed down her leafy dress. "You are moving a lot of power out there!"
"I need your help again, Mimi... I am sorry for burdening you with this so soon after the last time."
Mimi puffed out her chest and gave him a determined look. "It is my job, Scary Uncle! I am the guardian of your soul!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1441 Symbiosis
paragraphs: In the physical world, the atmosphere inside the dome shifted from rose-scented lust to a localized weather event.

Quinlan's Primordial Breeding Physique acted as the furnace. He began to draw upon the Fire and Earth elements first. Normally, these were used for external destruction, but Quinlan turned them inward. He fused them into a brutal density. His muscles didn't just bulge; they became as heavy and unyielding as tectonic plates, while his internal temperature spiked to a level that turned his sweat into a hissing cloud of steam.

Then came the Wind and Water. Using the Water element, he ensured his mana and blood remained fluid, preventing the Earth element from making him too rigid. It turned his internal circulation into a pressurized tidal wave. The Wind element was channeled directly into his nervous system, stripping away the lag between thought and action, granting him a speed that defied his massive weight.
"Scar," Quinlan grunted with his palm still crushing Nyxara's mouth.
"Yes, Master!" Scar pushed her soul energy through his back. She acted as the conduit that helped Quinlan send all his fierce elements straight into his soul realm.
The clearing within Quinlan's mind was no longer a sanctuary; it had become a cosmic battlefield.

As he pulled the four elements directly into his soul, the sky of his inner world fractured. Torrential rains of Water clashed with rising plumes of Fire, while the very ground beneath the fairy tree groaned, shifting like tectonic plates of Earth. A howling gale of Wind whipped through the branches, threatening to uproot his consciousness itself.

Mimi screamed in exertion as she threw her small arms around the trunk of the tree. The tree began to glow with a blinding white light, fighting to suppress the storm. In the physical world, Scar's skin began to spider-web with cracks as the sheer pressure of Quinlan's soul-storm leaked into her. She wasn't just a helper; she was the high-voltage cable connecting a collapsing star to a machine. Her blue skin pulsed with shifting colors, turning from emerald to crimson as she grabbed onto the energies Mimi managed to filter and funneled them right back into her Master's body. The raw, unrefined chaos from his soul then mashed against his Primordial Breeding Physique.
The physique, sensing the existential threat and the immense power, stopped being a passive shield. It roared to life, behaving like a hungry predator that had finally been given a real meal.

The light of his skin turned a deep, molten platinum. Every vein in Quinlan's body became a glowing circuit of elemental mana. His heartbeat didn't just thud; it sent physical shockwaves through the bed, vibrating the very air within the dome, filling it with the frequency of a collapsing star. With the four elements roaring through his marrow and Scar acting as his lightning rod, Quinlan's body had become something more than flesh. Each time he drove forward, the impact wasn't just physical; it was a tectonic event.
The sheer of his muscles made every thrust carry the weight of a mountain. Nyxara found herself pinned by a force that no longer felt like that of her little ruin.
Under his palm, her muffled screams took on a melodic, frantic quality. Her heart-shaped pupils weren't just throbbing anymore; they were spinning, struggling to process the sheer sensory overload.
'He's destroying me!❤️' she thought, her mind fracturing into a thousand shards of pure, unadulterated ecstasy. 'He's trying to rewrite my very essence... This is the best moment of my life!❤️❤️❤️'

The iridescent nectar she produced became a torrent, a slick lubricant that hissed as it met Quinlan's molten-platinum skin. The steam rising from their joined bodies filled the room with a thick, heady vapor, making the scene look like a fever dream of carnal war.

Quinlan offered her the absolute, crushing reality of his will. Nyxara's body went through a violent series of contractions. Her back arched so high it seemed her spine might snap, her breasts heaving, her skin flushing a deep, bruised violet. She came apart such that her consciousness dissolved into the rose-colored mist, only to be slammed back into reality by the unrelenting rhythm of Quinlan's engine.

She began to grin under his hand while a wild, manic look appeared in her already crazed eyes. The burn of the mana friction, the weight of him pushing her down deep into the mattress, his relentless ravaging of her insides - it was all she had ever dreamed of.

Just as Quinlan felt her body prepare for a total collapse, Nyxara's own Limitless Lust Physique flared in response to the existential threat. She wasn't a Primordial Demon of Lust because she was easy to conquer.

Her legs, slick with sweat and nectar, suddenly snapped shut around Quinlan's waist like a vice. Her long, sharp nails bit deep into the glowing tracks of his back, drawing trails of blood. Despite the hand over her mouth, she managed to release a hiss.
"You think... you can just conquer me? I will not give you the satisfaction of victory so easily... I'll keep you here until your soul burns out!"
Her internal muscles clamped down with the force of a hydraulic press, her own dark mana surging to meet his elemental storm.

The strain finally reached its breaking point. In the soul realm, Mimi let out one last, shaky breath as the fairy tree's white light solidified into a permanent crystalline shell. Her small hands slipped from the bark, and she slumped into the soft grass, drifting into a deep, restorative unconsciousness.

In the physical world, Scar's eyes rolled back. The cracks in her blue skin began to glow with a residual sapphire light before she collapsed sideways onto the splintered remains of the bed frame. She had done it; she had held the bridge long enough for the transition to complete.
Quinlan was no longer just a man; he was a localized phenomenon of elemental fusion.

With the conduits gone, the power consolidated. The four elements, now perfectly filtered through his soul energies by Mimi and funneled by Scar, merged within his body. Quinlan felt his consciousness expand, his soul and body finally vibrating in a singular, terrifying harmony.
He leaned down and exhaled. As he did so, his breath came out as a visible, scorching mist.

He moved his free hand, the one not pinning her head, and slid it down her sweat-slicked torso. His touch left glowing trails of platinum heat on her violet skin. His palm finally came to rest over her lower abdomen, right where the pink womb tattoo was throbbing with a frantic, desperate light.
The tattoo was the seat of her power, the linchpin of her Limitless Lust. Quinlan flooded his hand with the density of his mana, turning his palm into a branding iron.
"With this, you belong to me," he declared.

The moment his elemental heat collided with her demonic mark, a sound like a lightning strike echoed through the dome. Steam hissed violently from the contact point as Quinlan began to overwrite her essence. The pink glow of the tattoo struggled for a heartbeat before it was forcibly drowned out by a searing, molten platinum light.
Nyxara's reaction was instantaneous and violent.
"AHHHNNNGGHH!"

Her voice broke into a high-pitched, shattering squeal. Her internal muscles didn't just clamp; they went into a full-blown rhythmic seizure, milking him with a desperation that would have ended any other man in milliseconds. Her hands flew from his back, her long nails digging into the mattress with such force that it was torn apart.

Her eyes went completely white, her head thrashing as the orgasm ripped through her, amplified a hundredfold by the branding of her womb. The iridescent nectar gushed in a relentless tide, the sound of their union becoming a wet, splashing roar that filled the room.
Quinlan didn't stop. He accelerated.

Every strike sent a pulse of his elemental mana directly into her core, into her very soul, marking the inside of her thighs, her belly, and her whole existence with glowing sigils of his own making. He was literally forging her into his object.

Nyxara's body was a wreck of trembling violet skin and sweat, her back arching so high that only her toes and her head touched the floor. She was drowning in the sheer scale of the pleasure-pain he was inflicting.

Yet, as the peak of her climax finally began to plateau, she didn't collapse. Her demonic nature, fueled by the very destruction he was dealing, found its footing. She blinked, her heart-shaped pupils returning, now wider and more crazed than ever.

She looked up at him through the steam with her chest heaving. She didn't try to push him off. This demon never fought against Quinlan in a physical matter; to her, this was a bedroom warfare for dominance. Resisting with punches and pushes went completely against everything.
Thus, even as he was branding and ruining her body, she never resisted as a fighter might.
She was fighting in her own way, in the way the Primordial Demon of Lust fought her battles.
Nyxara let out a jagged, wet laugh, her tongue darting out to lick a bead of mana-sweat from her upper lip.
"Is that... all you've got?" she hissed, her voice a mix of a growl and a moan. "It's not enough... It'll never be enough!"
Her legs locked even tighter around his waist, her heels digging into his glutes as she tilted her pelvis up to meet his next strike with a thud that shook the room.
The battle for the womb was far from over.

As he pulled the four elements directly into his soul, the sky of his inner world fractured.
Torrential rains of Water clashed with rising plumes of Fire, while the very ground beneath the fairy tree groaned, shifting like tectonic plates of Earth.
A howling gale of Wind whipped through the branches, threatening to uproot his consciousness itself.
Mimi screamed in exertion as she threw her small arms around the trunk of the tree.
The tree began to glow with a blinding white light, fighting to suppress the storm.
In the physical world, Scar's skin began to spider-web with cracks as the sheer pressure of Quinlan's soul-storm leaked into her.
She wasn't just a helper; she was the high-voltage cable connecting a collapsing star to a machine.
Her blue skin pulsed with shifting colors, turning from emerald to crimson as she grabbed onto the energies Mimi managed to filter and funneled them right back into her Master's body.
The raw, unrefined chaos from his soul then mashed against his Primordial Breeding Physique.
The physique, sensing the existential threat and the immense power, stopped being a passive shield.
It roared to life, behaving like a hungry predator that had finally been given a real meal.
The light of his skin turned a deep, molten platinum.
Every vein in Quinlan's body became a glowing circuit of elemental mana.
His heartbeat didn't just thud; it sent physical shockwaves through the bed, vibrating the very air within the dome, filling it with the frequency of a collapsing star.
With the four elements roaring through his marrow and Scar acting as his lightning rod, Quinlan's body had become something more than flesh.
Each time he drove forward, the impact wasn't just physical; it was a tectonic event.
The sheer of his muscles made every thrust carry the weight of a mountain.
Nyxara found herself pinned by a force that no longer felt like that of her little ruin.
Under his palm, her muffled screams took on a melodic, frantic quality.
Her heart-shaped pupils weren't just throbbing anymore; they were spinning, struggling to process the sheer sensory overload.
'He's destroying me!❤️' she thought, her mind fracturing into a thousand shards of pure, unadulterated ecstasy. 'He's trying to rewrite my very essence...
This is the best moment of my life!❤️❤️❤️'
The iridescent nectar she produced became a torrent, a slick lubricant that hissed as it met Quinlan's molten-platinum skin.
The steam rising from their joined bodies filled the room with a thick, heady vapor, making the scene look like a fever dream of carnal war.
Quinlan offered her the absolute, crushing reality of his will.
Nyxara's body went through a violent series of contractions.
Her back arched so high it seemed her spine might snap, her breasts heaving, her skin flushing a deep, bruised violet.
She came apart such that her consciousness dissolved into the rose-colored mist, only to be slammed back into reality by the unrelenting rhythm of Quinlan's engine.
She began to grin under his hand while a wild, manic look appeared in her already crazed eyes.
The burn of the mana friction, the weight of him pushing her down deep into the mattress, his relentless ravaging of her insides - it was all she had ever dreamed of.
Just as Quinlan felt her body prepare for a total collapse, Nyxara's own Limitless Lust Physique flared in response to the existential threat.
She wasn't a Primordial Demon of Lust because she was easy to conquer.
Her legs, slick with sweat and nectar, suddenly snapped shut around Quinlan's waist like a vice.
Her long, sharp nails bit deep into the glowing tracks of his back, drawing trails of blood.
Despite the hand over her mouth, she managed to release a hiss.
"You think... you can just conquer me?
I will not give you the satisfaction of victory so easily...
I'll keep you here until your soul burns out!"
Her internal muscles clamped down with the force of a hydraulic press, her own dark mana surging to meet his elemental storm.
The strain finally reached its breaking point.
In the soul realm, Mimi let out one last, shaky breath as the fairy tree's white light solidified into a permanent crystalline shell.
Her small hands slipped from the bark, and she slumped into the soft grass, drifting into a deep, restorative unconsciousness.
In the physical world, Scar's eyes rolled back.
The cracks in her blue skin began to glow with a residual sapphire light before she collapsed sideways onto the splintered remains of the bed frame.
She had done it; she had held the bridge long enough for the transition to complete.
Quinlan was no longer just a man; he was a localized phenomenon of elemental fusion.
With the conduits gone, the power consolidated.
The four elements, now perfectly filtered through his soul energies by Mimi and funneled by Scar, merged within his body.
Quinlan felt his consciousness expand, his soul and body finally vibrating in a singular, terrifying harmony.
He leaned down and exhaled.
As he did so, his breath came out as a visible, scorching mist.
He moved his free hand, the one not pinning her head, and slid it down her sweat-slicked torso.
His touch left glowing trails of platinum heat on her violet skin.
His palm finally came to rest over her lower abdomen, right where the pink womb tattoo was throbbing with a frantic, desperate light.
The tattoo was the seat of her power, the linchpin of her Limitless Lust.
Quinlan flooded his hand with the density of his mana, turning his palm into a branding iron.
"With this, you belong to me," he declared.
The moment his elemental heat collided with her demonic mark, a sound like a lightning strike echoed through the dome.
Steam hissed violently from the contact point as Quinlan began to overwrite her essence.
The pink glow of the tattoo struggled for a heartbeat before it was forcibly drowned out by a searing, molten platinum light.
Nyxara's reaction was instantaneous and violent.
"AHHHNNNGGHH!"
Her voice broke into a high-pitched, shattering squeal.
Her internal muscles didn't just clamp; they went into a full-blown rhythmic seizure, milking him with a desperation that would have ended any other man in milliseconds.
Her hands flew from his back, her long nails digging into the mattress with such force that it was torn apart.
Her eyes went completely white, her head thrashing as the orgasm ripped through her, amplified a hundredfold by the branding of her womb.
The iridescent nectar gushed in a relentless tide, the sound of their union becoming a wet, splashing roar that filled the room.
Quinlan didn't stop.
He accelerated.
Every strike sent a pulse of his elemental mana directly into her core, into her very soul, marking the inside of her thighs, her belly, and her whole existence with glowing sigils of his own making.
He was literally forging her into his object.
Nyxara's body was a wreck of trembling violet skin and sweat, her back arching so high that only her toes and her head touched the floor.
She was drowning in the sheer scale of the pleasure-pain he was inflicting.
Yet, as the peak of her climax finally began to plateau, she didn't collapse.
Her demonic nature, fueled by the very destruction he was dealing, found its footing.
She blinked, her heart-shaped pupils returning, now wider and more crazed than ever.
She looked up at him through the steam with her chest heaving.
She didn't try to push him off.
This demon never fought against Quinlan in a physical matter; to her, this was a bedroom warfare for dominance.
Resisting with punches and pushes went completely against everything.
Thus, even as he was branding and ruining her body, she never resisted as a fighter might.
She was fighting in her own way, in the way the Primordial Demon of Lust fought her battles.
Nyxara let out a jagged, wet laugh, her tongue darting out to lick a bead of mana-sweat from her upper lip.
"Is that... all you've got?" she hissed, her voice a mix of a growl and a moan.
"It's not enough...
It'll never be enough!"
Her legs locked even tighter around his waist, her heels digging into his glutes as she tilted her pelvis up to meet his next strike with a thud that shook the room.
The battle for the womb was far from over.

chapters.title: Chapter 1442 Harbinger of Ruin
paragraphs: As Quinlan poured his essence into her, Nyxara's Limitless Lust Physique didn't just endure; it thrived once again. The platinum mark he had branded onto her lower abdomen flickered as the pink, heart-shaped energy of the demoness surged back like a rising tide. She was using the very essence he deposited within her as fuel to reconstruct her dominance.

"More... I want more of you!❤️ Fill me up!❤️ My Ruin~❤️" she gasped, her body vibrating with a terrifying resilience. Every time he ejaculated inside her, she absorbed the impact, her internal muscles weaving his power into her own.

Quinlan realized that better wasn't enough. He was a pressurized vessel of disparate forces: the density of Fire and Earth, the Hydro-Neural speed of Water and Wind, the exhausted but crystallized stability of his soul realm, and the predatory hunger of his Primordial Breeding Physique.

He stopped viewing them as separate tools and instead forced them into a singular, agonizing point of singularity. It felt like trying to compress a sun into a grain of sand. The friction between the elements began to generate a new form of energy, a violent, hyper-conducting resonance.

His skin didn't just glow; it darkened into a polished, obsidian-like sheen, shot through with veins of white-hot elemental mana. To Nyxara, he no longer looked like a man. He looked like an Elemental Demon, a primal force of nature that had donned a cloak of flesh just to ravage her.
"Enough playing," Quinlan growled.
He pulled his arm back for a moment just to bring it down in a sharp, thunderous slap against her womb.

"NNGGHHAA!❤️❤️❤️" The impact sent a shockwave through her entire frame, forcing an instantaneous, lung-shattering orgasm that left her eyes rolled back. Quinlan left a tether of his energy there, a seal of his physique that kept the fight without his palm needing to retain the physical connection between their skin.
Before she could even recover her breath, Quinlan used his freed-up hands to reach down and grip her waist. With a primal roar of exertion, he stood up.

He hoisted Nyxara off the floor with her back pressed flush against his chest in a brutal, standing reverse-carry. He hooked his arms under her knees, pinning her and locking his hands behind her neck, forcing her head to look down at the ground.

He began to drop into a heavy, vertical rhythm. Each time he drove upward, making the impact sound like a hammer hitting an anvil. The bed beneath them finally disintegrated entirely under the sheer pressure of his stance.
"Surrender!" Quinlan commanded into her ear.
"Never!" she shrieked. "Break me! Destroy me! But I will... I will never-!"

Quinlan's eyes snapped open, glowing with a blinding, monochromatic light. He reached into the friction of his combined elements. By spinning the Wind at the speed of thought through the Water-fluidity of his mana, and grounding it through the Earth-density of his bones, he sparked a reaction: Elemental Electricity.
Jagged bolts of white and violet lightning began to arc between their sweating bodies.

As the elemental electricity surged through Quinlan, it bridged the gap between his soul and hers, turning the point of their union into a high-voltage conduit. But Nyxara was not a mere fledgling succubus; she was the Primordial Demon of Lust, a creature who had spent eons feasting on the lives of heroes. Even as the platinum brand burned into her womb, her Limitless Lust Physique roared in a final defiance. Instead of collapsing, Nyxara's body bucked with a renewed, frantic vigor. Her heart-shaped pupils fractured, glowing with a dark, neon pink that fought to push back Quinlan's molten light.
"Is... that... all?!" she gasped, her voice a jagged melody of pain and fanatical pleasure.

She leaned into the lightning. Rather than recoiling from the electrical siege, she opened herself to it, attempting to digest the elemental destruction. Her internal muscles, empowered by her ancient willpower, began to move with a complex, rhythmic autonomy, a vortex designed to drain Quinlan dry before he could finish his branding.
She was fighting him with the weapon that denoted her whole life: an endurance born of eternal gluttony. She reached back and gripped his hair, pulling him closer.
"Your fire is just... another meal!❤️"

As Nyxara leaned back against his firm chest, she pulled his head down with a triumphant, feline hiss. Her neck was arched, the pale violet skin stretched taut, revealing the frantic, rhythmic thrumming of her carotid artery. To her, this was the ultimate display of dominance, forcing her Ruin to witness her gluttony up close as she prepared to swallow his essence whole.
But Quinlan's eyes weren't filled with the glazed haze of lust. They were cold, analytical, and predatory.
Deep within the archives of his mind, a notification he had brushed aside long ago flickered into existence.
[Class Unlock Condition: Blood Mage]
Drink the blood of a level 70+ entity (Incomplete).
Obtain a blood storage artifact and fill it to the brim with the blood of your slain enemies. Must be at least 1,000 liters (Incomplete).
The second was still out of his reach, but the first...?
A dark, ruthless grin tugged at the corner of his mouth. Nyxara wanted to be a consumer of his very being?
Two could play that game.
He leaned into her touch, and before the demoness could register the shift in his aura, he opened his mouth and sank his teeth deep into the side of her neck.

While the trial took place inside the primordial dimension, where damage was undone within moments, the dome itself worked differently. Inside, taking damage was more than possible, evidenced by all the blood and pain their exchange caused thus far.
This was no different, just taken to the next level.
"Ggh!?"
The sound Nyxara made was a choked, confused gasp. It wasn't a bite of passion; it was a visceral, carnal harvesting. Quinlan's canines tore through the delicate skin, puncturing the vein.
The blood of a Primordial Demon tasted nothing like what he could describe.
Liquid starlight, spiced with a heat that threatened to incinerate his throat, perhaps...?

As he gulped down the searing, thick fluid, a notification flashed in the corner of his vision, but he ignored it. He was focused on the sensation of her life-force entering his system, mixing with the elemental fire already roaring in his marrow.

The effect on Nyxara was catastrophic. The Vortex she had created to drain him stalled as her own life force was suddenly being siphoned away from the top. The shock of the violation, of being prey in the very moment she claimed victory, shattered her rhythm.

Her internal muscles seized, not in a tactical drain of his manhood, but in a series of violent, uncontrollable spasms that still managed to milk Quinlan with a desperate, mind-shattering intensity. However, the scales had tipped.

She was in a worse state, continuously and perpetually orgasming from the sheer, brutal wrongness of it, her head thrashing against his shoulder as she felt her blood and her lust being claimed simultaneously.
Quinlan felt the drain at his center vanish, replaced by an explosive surge of power. The demon blood acted as a stabilizer for the four elements.
"Accept it..." Quinlan growled against the wound in her neck, his voice muffled by the copper-sweet taste of her. "You belong to me. Resistance is futile, demon!"
He reached into the absolute depths of his soul and sent the Soul-Pulse.

The platinum mark on her womb erupted, together with a rush of lightning that traversed her whole body in a single moment. Jagged, crystalline roots of molten mana dove deep into her core, wrapping around her demonic heart. Nyxara's eyes went wide. She realized, too late, that her gluttony had been her undoing. She couldn't consume him. He was too big. He was too much. He was everything.
"My Ruin..." she whispered.
The final barrier of the Primordial Demon's pride disintegrated just like that.

Nyxara's head snapped back, her body arching so violently that she nearly slipped out of Quinlan's binding hold. Her jaw unhinged fully, and from the very bottom of her eternal soul, she released the Shriek of Ruin.

It was a sound that defied description, a raw, high-pitched sonic boom of absolute, soul-shattering submission. It was the sound of a sovereign abdicating her throne, the sound of an ancient creature finding her Harbinger of Ruin. To any other succubus, the sound would have been a death knell; to Nyxara, it was the most raw, honest emotion she had felt in her billions of years of life.
It was her confession. She no longer wanted to lead.
She wanted to be claimed.

As the shriek echoed into the burning air, Nyxara's body went limp. Quinlan felt the extraction complete. The violet and pink energy of her lineage flowed into the platinum sigils on her skin and then into him. He felt his veins expand, his heartbeat slowing to a heavy, powerful thud that shook the dome.

Nyxara looked up at him through a haze of broken, ecstatic bliss. "My Harbinger of Ruin... I'm yours... For Eternity and Beyond... Treat me well, okay?❤️" Her pupils went from pink hearts to solid, glowing platinum, mirroring the man who had ruined her. She let out one last, soft whimper, a sound of pure, conquered adoration, and drifted into the void, turning translucent, as if ready to disappear at a moment's notice.
The world around them fractured. The dome shattered, and Quinlan's mind became assaulted by a torrent of messages.
[Primordial Trial Conquered.]
[Evolution Underway...]

Oh, Zhenwu.
I probably lost hundreds of paying readers in that arc.

chapters.title: Chapter 1443 Possessed by a Slut
paragraphs: Quinlan looked down.
Nyxara's body was on the ground, but it was wrong.
Her form was fading, emptying.

The glow in her eyes had dimmed to a thin, glassy sheen. Her skin, once taut with vitality, had begun to hollow inward, as if something fundamental was being withdrawn from behind it. Color leeched away in slow, uneven currents.
She was withering away.
Quinlan did not move, did not rush to her aid.
His heart remained firm as his mind dissected the possibilities with ruthless calm.
Decay? It felt a bit too clean for that... Backlash from the shriek?
Was she dying?
The thought registered without urgency.

If his pounding had reduced the Primordial Demon of Lust to a collapsing husk, that was a fact worth remembering. A feat to file away. A story to brag about for the next billion years. Her chest rose once. Then again.
Her breathing was shallow and felt unnatural, hollow.
"What's going on with you?" Quinlan murmured.
Nyxara's lips parted, but no sound came out.
Then her form stopped deteriorating.
For a single heartbeat, everything froze.
The air locked in place.
The remaining light inside her compressed inward.
Her outline sharpened, edges pulling tight, as if reality itself was bracing.
Nyxara's body burst.

Not outward in gore but inward, fragmenting into countless motes of radiant pink and violet dust. Each particle glimmered with a soft, crystalline glow, carrying echoes of heat, hunger, and ancient will.
They turned. Every particle reoriented toward Quinlan at once.
A death surge?
A final strike?
Some demonic retaliation encoded into her system to be activated upon defeat?
His instincts flared instantly.
Water exploded around his body in a reflexive barrier, dense and layered. Wind detonated outward from his core in a concussive burst, shoving space itself away as he leapt back.
The particles passed through all of it, slipping between currents, through pressure, through resistance, as if none of it had ever been there.
Returning. Or rather, finding their rightful new home...
That's what this was. Quinlan tensed his muscles as the first motes reached him.
They sank into his skin without pain, dissolving instantly upon contact. He felt no harm.
More followed. Thousands. Tens of thousands. A river of demonic essence pouring into him, threading through muscle, bone, and soul with intimate familiarity.
Once in his system, the flow curved.

Every mote adjusted its course at once, arcing toward his back as if guided by an unseen hand. The air behind him grew warm. Then tight. The particles spread outward in precise lines, sketching themselves into permanence.
A tattoo bloomed across his back.
Pink. Lush. Ornate.
Curved demonic sigils traced the outline of a succubus crest, elegant and unmistakably feminine. Its lines were luminous and its core pulsed with a soft, rhythmic glow.
His spine straightened on reflex.

"So cruel," a voice whimpered inside his head, threaded with quiet reproach. "You thought I died in our duel, and your first thought was how you would brag about breeding the primordial succubus to death for the next billion years."
Quinlan closed his eyes and let out a long breath.
"Please tell me I did not just get possessed by a slutty demon," he groaned.
"What a terrible reaction!! My Ruin can't be this cruel to his cute and loving demoness right after eliciting her Shriek of Ruin!" Nyxara whined.
Quinlan let the breath out slowly through his nose.

"You would have consumed my whole being if I accepted."
Silence stretched for a beat.
"Hehe! Let's ignore the irrelevant details, okay?❤️"
Quinlan rubbed his face with one hand and sighed again, longer this time. "So. This Shriek of Ruin. You attached yourself to me."
A pleased hum rippled through his thoughts. "Attached is such an ugly word. Bound sounds hotter. Claimed is even sexier."
He felt her presence curl closer, warm and pleased.

"You are the one man who I accepted to stand above me," Nyxara explained with a low, sensual voice. Although she wasn't present in the physical sense, Quinlan felt as though he was back in her embrace, hugged tightly by the demoness. "The man who conquered me. My fate is joined to yours now. I am your loyal demoness for eternity. I will never betray you. I will never abandon you."
"... Shouldn't this be consensual?" he muttered. "I won, but I don't even get a say in this?"

She laughed softly, the sound practically purring against his thoughts. "Oh, my Ruin is so full of complaints... It's as if he didn't just conquer the hottest succubus in the world. You should rejoice, not brood..."
"I am being extremely reasonable right now."
"Hehe! This would not have happened if you had not wanted it. Deep down, where it matters, you are happy to have me. You just don't know it yet.❤️"
Quinlan instantly groaned upon hearing such nonsense. "Goddess save me. I did not sign up for this."
A chime echoed through his awareness just then.
[Ding!]
[Primordial Trial Conquered.]
Something deep inside him shifted.

His body answered the presence settling into it with layers of power realigning as if acknowledging a foreign banner planted within its borders. Heat rolled through his chest, dense and controlled, carrying the unmistakable signature of his Primordial Breeding Physique.
The response was not welcoming.
It was territorial.

A pressure formed beneath his sternum, then surfaced through skin and bone alike. Dark lines etched themselves across his chest, spreading outward in sharp, angular patterns. Where Nyxara's mark on his back was curved, ornate, and undeniably feminine, this was heavy and masculine, built for dominance rather than allure.
The two marks reacted.
The pink sigil on his back flared, its glow intensifying as if bristling. The dark crest on his chest answered in kind, its presence pushing back, asserting priority.
Inside his body, power collided.
"What is this?" Nyxara gasped. "My right to be present is being questioned?"
Quinlan let out a short, breathless chuckle as he thought about the pink mark on his back. "Maybe your aesthetic just does not fit."
"What? But it's so cute."
The pressure surged, as if outright denying the truth of her words.
Neither yielded.

The markings pulled at each other, lines stretching through his flesh, heat and weight converging toward his core. The clash compressed him, forces grinding together until resistance gave way to synthesis.
[Ding!]
[Evolution Underway...]
The colors bled.

Pink deepened into crimson. Soft curves sharpened. The dark sigils fractured, then reformed, their edges burning with a blood-red sheen against night-black lines. The patterns spread across his torso and back alike, no longer separate, no longer competing.
They became one.
A lattice of demonic script and primordial authority etched into his skin.
Nyxara went quiet.
Then she let out a slow moan, audibly going into heat. "I will admit."
There was a pause, her tone lingering as if she were tracing the lines herself.
"This does look much better on you. So manly! I want to eat you up all over again!!"
But while the horny demon kept spouting her horny nonsense, new lines of messages arrived in Quinlan's mind.
