chapters.title: Chapter 1444 Evolving...
paragraphs: [Primordial Trial Conquered.]
[Dominant Claim Confirmed.]
[Nyxara, Primordial Demon of Lust: Essence Bound.]
Heat surged from Quinlan's core, steady at first, then heavier, as if something had latched onto the rhythm of his heartbeat.
[Human and Demon: Unified.]
[Conqueror and Conquered: Bound.]
Nyxara's presence slid deeper into him. For half a second, everything aligned.
Then something pressed back.
His body was intact. His soul was intact. The pressure came from somewhere else entirely.
From volume.
The world sharpened around him as he became aware of the strain running through his flesh.
[Warning.]
[Structural Instability Detected.]
Inside him, something vast pushed outward, testing limits that had not been meant to hold it. Muscle resisted. Bone held. His skin pulled tight, refusing to stretch further.
Nyxara screamed.
"No!"
The incessantly moaning succubus was gone, replaced by a concerned demoness. "Stop it! You're being torn apart! Fight it, now! If you let this continue, you'll break!"
Quinlan didn't do as told.
He didn't brace. He didn't push back. Instead, calmly, he closed his eyes and looked inward.
Elemental mastery threaded through muscle and nerve, woven directly into his body.
Nyxara's abyssal authority somehow combined with his Primordial Breeding Physique.
Then there was the soul domain business as well... Understanding settled in him.
Too much. It was just too much.
"Resisting now would kill me."
"What?" Nyxara snapped. "Did you rattle your brain when you electrocuted me with your manhood? Is that why you bit my neck?!"
"This isn't an attack," Quinlan decreed while ignoring the woman's nonsense as he had learned to do during their battle so that he could maintain focus and regenerate mana. "It's capacity expansion."
The pressure climbed.

It dragged along his skin from the inside, hot and unyielding, as if his body were being stretched around something that refused to shrink. Back when he first awakened the Primordial Breeding Physique, the sensation had been similar.

He remembered the wooden inn's floorboards beneath his back. The way his hands had clawed into it. The sound of his own voice breaking as his body rebuilt itself without mercy. Blossom's concerned form hovered nearby, worried out of her mind for his safety.
That time, he had been overwhelmed.
This time, he stayed upright.

The tearing worsened. Heat crawled under his skin in lines, following the red-black markings already etched into him, tracing them deeper. His breath slowed instead of hitching. His shoulders remained level.
Nyxara shouted something in his mind. He barely registered the words.

He remembered forcing his body past failure during their battle. The way his muscles had screamed while he kept moving anyway. The way his senses had sharpened the closer he came to collapse. He remembered that edge, that narrow space where the body begged to stop and the will answered by pushing harder.
This was the same place.
The pressure peaked, grinding through him with methodical intent. His vision wavered. His jaw tightened once, then relaxed.
Suddenly, Quinlan was forced to realize that he was even enjoying the process in a morbid way...
'There's no way breeding a slutty succubus turned me into an M...' he grumbled, analyzing why he was excited.
'Ah. It should've been obvious.'
He felt the way he did because he knew what this meant.
Every pulse of strain carried information. Every tearing line came with weight, with permanence. His body was not being punished. It was being rewritten to keep up.
A low breath left his chest, steady and controlled.
Heat flooded him again, deeper, denser. The markings along his skin flared and spread with purpose, locking into place along his shoulders and neck as if they had always been meant to be there.
Quinlan remained still.
'Let it tear,' he thought calmly.
'Let it grow.'
[Entity Load Exceeds Vessel Parameters.]
Nyxara's voice wavered. "Little Ruin... Your body isn't failing, it's... lagging behind you."
"That's because it's built for what I was."
The tearing reached a peak. His vision dimmed at the edges, but his stance remained unchanged.
[Current Physique Insufficient.]
[Adaptive Solution Initiated.]
[Requirement Identified: Expanded vessel capable of sustaining bound demonic essence, elemental integration, and sovereign soul structure.]
Heat flooded his body again, but it was different from before. The tearing turned into reconstruction.
His muscles tightened, densifying. His bones sang under the strain, reforged. The red-black markings along his skin burned, spreading with purpose, locking into new patterns across his skin.
[Ding!]
[New Primordial Physique Unlocked.]
[Primordial Breeding Physique → Abyssal Genesis Physique.]
Nyxara gasped.
The pressure vanished.
Quinlan drew a slow breath and opened his eyes.
The world came back into focus with a new clarity. The familiar weight of his body was still there, but it felt... denser. More present.
He lifted his gaze and summoned a wall of water, observing his body.
His eyes had changed.

The fourfold elemental hues he once carried had fused into a single tone, smooth and reflective, a pale platinum sheen that held light without reflecting it back. Warmth rolled across his skin thanks to the markings. The heat was familiar. It carried the same steady virility Nyxara's skin had radiated when she had pressed into him in the bed, heat that invited without demanding.
"Abyssal Genesis Physique..." Quinlan murmured.
His frame was unchanged and the markings didn't cover his whole body; they were concentrated on his chest, back, and shoulders.
There was no sudden bulk, no monstrous distortion.

The difference was mostly inside, evidenced by Quinlan feeling more in tune with himself than ever before. His powers felt more 'his.' More in his control than awarded to him by the omnipresent entity called the Soul Records, or the universe itself, or however the world worked. Quinlan didn't know yet.
What he knew was that it felt as though he made a giant leap in establishing his own essence, separate from the established great forces. Quinlan smiled faintly.
"Mostly internal changes, huh?" he noted.
His eyes traced the patterns again. They looked... good.

"Admit it~" Nyxara purred into his thoughts, her voice already sliding back into its usual cadence. "You love it. You think it's badass, epic, and all that nonsense masculinity stuff you men care so much about."
Then... the succubus's voice rose into a much higher pitch, turning into a mighty squeal. "And I agree! I can't wait to be pinned beneath you as-"
Quinlan closed his eyes.
He focused inward once again and found her presence coiled comfortably.
He flicked his fingers.
The voice cut off mid-thought.
"Silence, finally," he exhaled happily.

Quinlan opened his eyes again and rolled his shoulder. He then got an idea and started pulling the markings back with his will alone. The symbols responded, then faded, sinking back beneath his skin until he looked just as he had beforehand.
But when he released them, they instantly reappeared, reclaiming their rightful position.
"So that's how it works," he mused quietly.
The marks were not mere decoration, not mere tattoos. They were something more, something deeper than that.

"This is my new form..." Quinlan murmured, and just as Nyxara had deduced, he was extremely pleased with his current physical state. Quinlan wasn't one to ink his skin with decorative symbols, but when it was like this... When the markings were connected to the very depths of his essence, representing who he became, well... He loved them.
However, if ever came the need or desire to appear fully human again, he could pull the marks back.
'How cool...' he mused inwardly with a small grin.
Then his gaze dropped.
Scar lay a short distance away, unmoving.

chapters.title: Chapter 1445 Still Master!
paragraphs: Quinlan instantly changed his attitude, admonishing himself. "Damn... What a bad master I am. I got carried away with studying these strange developments when I should've ensured you were okay. I'm sorry, Scar."

He crossed the space in a few steps and knelt beside her. Her breathing was shallow. Her blue, ethereal skin was torn and marked by strain, the cost of serving as the bridge that had let his elements pass cleanly, that had let his soul and body align when it mattered most.
He slid an arm beneath her back and another under her knees, lifting.
Her weight felt truly insignificant in his arms.
Quinlan held her close.

"Thank you for always being so dependable, Scar. I sometimes get the feeling I don't deserve you..." He said, despite her not being in a state to hear his words. "The boy is talking to an unconscious woman with his willy out for all to see," came a male voice. "Has he snapped? What a shame..."
Quinlan lifted his head.
The pressure in the air had changed.

During the trial, the world around him had sealed off, compressed into a private battlefield where only he and Nyxara existed. The dome had blocked sight, sound, and anything resembling outside interference. Now the barrier was gone.
The dome that had wrapped the area as a second sky had collapsed without fanfare.
Open air stretched above him.
The horizon returned, and the familiar signatures of dozens of presences standing just beyond the former boundary became apparent.
People.
All of them.
His girls. His allies. The primordials.
They had formed a loose ring around the area where the dome once stood, each one staring directly at him.
At his very exposed form.
Quinlan glanced down.
"...Right," he muttered.
The comment had come from the left.
Karl stood there with his usual pig snout, which was now wrinkled. "Synchra," Quinlan called.
The response came instantly.
A familiar pulse moved through his body as his Anima answered.
She always did.
Heat traced across his skin in thin lines. Red fire slid over his hips and thighs first, flowing upward and downward at the same time, clinging to him like silk.
Synchra wrapped around him just like that, hiding her master's privates from everyone's eyes.
Just then, a streak of blonde appeared in his eyes.
Blossom crossed the distance fast enough to kick up dirt, boots skidding as she stopped right in front of him.
Then she leaned in.
And started sniffing him.
Rapid, sharp breaths against his chest, his neck, his shoulder.
Her nose brushed his skin again and again, golden ears twitching hard, blue eyes wide and unsettled.
"It's me, Blossom," Quinlan chuckled.

"Blossom trusts Master, but she needs to know it's Master!" she decreed, and the sniffing continued as the dogkin used her senses to ensure the man before her was the same man who earned her eternal loyalty and love.
While that was going on, two more presences crashed into him.
"Quinnie!"
Luminara and Mearie reached him almost at the same time and pulled him into fierce embraces.
He still held Scar; her body remained limp against his chest.
Quinlan adjusted smoothly, sliding her into the crook of one arm so her head rested safely against him while his free side opened for them.
He refused to set this amazing girl down on the ground after she suffered so much for his sake.
His other arm wrapped around both women and pulled them close.
Their grip tightened instantly, fingers digging into his back and shoulder as if confirming he had truly come out of it alive.
"I told you I could do it," Quinlan grinned.
"You're too reckless!!" Mearie snapped, voice shaking despite the scolding tone.
Luminara pressed her forehead to his chest while clenching her fists. "That sadistic demon toyed with our son for so long... And all we could do was grit our teeth and bear with it!"
"We'll deal with her," Mearie added sharply.
"I don't think there's a need for that..." Quinlan chuckled. "She seems to be controlled pretty well."
"I'll still have to converse with that woman later. She deserves to be punished!" Luminara hissed.

Hard.

paragraphs: Her arms slid around his neck.
"Congratulations on your success and welcome back, my arrogant primordial..." she whispered lovingly.
Quinlan's arm wrapped around her waist automatically, returning the embrace.
His hand drifted lower without shame, settling on her backside and giving her perky butt a firm squeeze. Possessive and entirely natural. At least so it felt to the both of them.
Ayame scoffed under her breath.
"Yep. Still the same..."
She leaned into him instead of pulling away, even rising onto her toes to give him better leverage, like she fully approved of the hold.
Her nose brushed his collar.
She sniffed once.
Twice.
"And you don't even carry the foul stench of a slut despite spending more than a week lying with one," she added, eyes narrowing slightly. "How curious..."
Quinlan laughed.
"Maybe it never even happened. It could just be your imagination. No evidence, after all."
She gave him a flat look.
Then smacked his skin lightly.
"Nice try."
Her finger traced one of the glowing lines along his neck.
"For evidence, I'll take your wild demonic marks as proof of your crime."
"Circumstantial at best," Quinlan grinned.
"Not in the court of wives."
They both broke into laughter while sporting full grins. Their banter was something they both missed greatly.
Just like this, the tension from earlier finally bled away.
Ayame pulled him down by the collar and kissed him again, longer this time, slow and affectionate, the kind of kiss that carried history instead of heat alone.
Her heart beat steadily against his chest.
His hand stayed on her butt.
The air around them finally felt right.
At least until a new, smooth, authoritative voice cut through the warmth.
"Synchra. Strip him."
Quinlan blinked.
He turned toward the source.

Kitsara stood a few steps away, tails swaying behind her in slow, elegant arcs. All three moved with lazy confidence, the white fur catching the light with every motion. Her golden eyes held that familiar, predatory gleam.
The kind that meant she had already decided what she wanted.
"My armor listens only to me-" Quinlan started.
Heat pulsed across his chest.
Synchra reacted.
Immediately.
The upper half of his armor peeled back like flowing liquid, retracting. Within a breath, his torso was bare again, markings exposed in full.
That said, his lower half stayed covered because Synchra complied only halfway.
Quinlan stared down at himself.
"... Traitor."
A soft, red flame replied to his accusation. It was as if the armor herself was curious as to what was going on and wanted to help the girls conduct their detective mission.
Kitsara slowly rubbed her thighs together, tails curling higher.
Her teeth caught her lower lip.
"Why are you so damned hot...?!" she breathed. "Let's celebrate!"
It took no genius to know what celebration she needed. This Slutty Foxy wanted to feel the Abyssal Genesis Physique right between her drenched thighs.
He adjusted Scar in his arms, looking down at the unconscious soul girl pressed against his chest.
"I'll have to check what's going on with her first."
His tone softened.
Then it sharpened again as he looked at the rest of them, full of desire that ever so slightly reminded the girls of Nyxara's hunger. She was truly inside him now, even if suppressed...
"But celebrations will come. Make no mistake."
A visible shiver passed through the group following his declaration.
Lucille's, Aurora's, and Vex's cheeks went red.
Seraphiel's and Kaelira's long elf ears twitched rapidly.
Kitsara's tails fluffed.
Blossom's tail wagged energetically.
Ayame rolled her eyes but failed to hide her smile.
Every single one of them was clearly imagining how exactly those celebrations might differ now, and their excitement levels grew with every passing moment.
Aurora's plump bosom bounced slightly as she took one step forward.
"Quin, plans for future celebrations aside, what exactly is this Abyssal Genesis Physique? My curiosity is killing me. What benefits did you gain from unlocking it?"
He paused.
"Right. I didn't read it yet."
A few of them groaned.
Quinlan focused inward and pulled up the familiar window.
The text formed quickly.
It was short.
Too short.
He frowned.
"Huh."
"What?" Aurora leaned in.
"All it says is..." he read aloud, "'Kept all prior benefits.'"
A pause.
"'Increased potential.'"
"That's it?"
"That's it," he confirmed. "No specifics. No breakdown. Just... increased potential."
Aurora adjusted her glasses, mind already racing.

"That's strange... Kept all prior benefits likely refers to your Primordial Breeding Physique's increased stats and... [Blessed Seed]... But the 'increased potential' part is strange... It feels like you're reaching further and further into uncharted territory. Maybe proper descriptions don't even exist for what you're becoming anymore."
Quinlan shrugged.
"Maybe. Or maybe the Soul Records is just lazy. Who knows. Either way, I'll have to run some tests."
Lucille spoke up slowly.
"You did ask for a utility-based upgrade when the trial started... maybe your physique adapted toward versatility..."
Her voice trailed off.
She bit her lip.
Her gaze dipped toward his waist for half a second before she looked back to his eyes.
"Your Blessed Seed might have different properties now... No? Different from before."
Quinlan smirked.
"Guess we'll have to run some tests."
"Okay... I'll help you..." she muttered bashfully, visibly full of excitement at the prospect. She just tried to retain decorum due to their large audience.
"Me too..." Aurora nodded.
"Guess I'll make the noble sacrifice of being the lab rat~" Seraphiel purred, showing much less bashfulness.
"Daughter!" Sylvaris hissed.
"Shush, Mom."
"Don't you dare shush me!"
"Ow! Don't pull my ear, you domestic abuser!" "..."
Quinlan watched the chaos with a smile.
Yeah.
Despite all that had happened, everything felt normal again.
That was when Serika stepped forward through the noise and reached out. Her fingertips brushed Scar's torn cheek gently.
Her expression softened.
Then she looked up and grinned.
"I, too, will happily volunteer to help you study your new physique," she said lightly. "But I can't help wondering what's going on with Scar."
Her thumb traced one of the faint cracks of light along Scar's blue skin.
"She died tons of times before. You just resummoned your Elite Souls every time. Is it different now?"
"Feels like it," Quinlan nodded.
He shifted Scar a little higher in his arms.
"Resurrecting my Elite Souls is only a matter of mana when they take physical damage. This... This is different. Her injury is more than physical. I'll have to look into it."
Then his expression darkened further.
"Also... Mimi helped me a lot alongside Scar in my fight against Nyxara. Poor girl seems unresponsive too... She should be okay, probably just tired, but we'd better make sure."
Serika's eyes widened instantly.
"Mimi too?!"
Her posture snapped straight.
"Okay, let's go right now."
Protective big sister mode had been activated.
The group shifted from teasing and flirting to focused concern in seconds.
Quinlan took one last breath of the open air, then closed his eyes.
Usually, accessing his soul realm required a deliberate pull. Mana gathered. Intent sharpened. He had to force open that inner door like prying apart two fused plates.
This time...
His Abyssal Genesis Physique reacted to his intent first.
The markings under his skin warmed.
Heat spread along his spine and ribs, then sank inward, deeper than flesh, deeper than bone. His heartbeat slowed and grew heavier, each pulse carrying through his entire body like a drum.
The space around him thinned.
It felt natural.
Too natural.
His soul domain responded as if it had been waiting.
A clean path formed.
There was no strain, no resistance.
The boundary between the primordial realm and his soul realm folded open like fabric being parted by a hand.
"...Huh," Quinlan muttered. "Increased potential...? Is this part of it?"
He could feel the connection with absurd clarity.
Before, it felt like drilling through stone.
Now it felt like opening a door in his own house.
Seamless.
As if his body had finally been built to properly utilize his soul realm.
Even the others sensed it.
Aurora blinked. "The space just warped..."
Kitsara's ears twitched. "You didn't even channel mana..."
Lucille stared. "You just... opened it..."
Quinlan frowned.
"...Yeah. I did."
That alone should have concerned him.
Still, Scar and Mimi came first.
He stepped forward, and the moment his feet touched the soil of his soul realm, his eyes widened.
"What in the Goddess' sexy lacy panties is going on here?" What awaited him inside his realm was a truly unexpected sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1447 New Soul Realm Ecosystem
paragraphs: Quinlan stepped forward, and the moment his feet touched the soil of his soul realm, his eyes widened.
"What in the Goddess' sexy lacy panties is going on here?"
The land itself was familiar. The rolling ground, the grass, and the distant slopes were all things he had seen before. That much had not changed.
What had changed was what grew between them.

Small shoots pushed through the soil in uneven clusters, leaves still soft and pale at the edges. Some plants leaned awkwardly, not yet sure how to stand. Others curled inward, protecting fragile stems that had only just broken through the ground. None of it looked refined or mature. Quinlan took a few more steps and stopped near one of the rivers.
The water had not been here before.
It flowed steadily through the land now. The current was gentle, carrying fine sediment that had not yet settled. He crouched slightly and focused.
Movement.
Tiny shapes darted beneath the surface, quick and uncertain. Small fish swam in short bursts, bumping into stones, correcting themselves, learning how the current worked.
"...You're kidding," Quinlan muttered.

He stepped closer to the riverbank and watched them for a few seconds longer. The water responded naturally to his presence, rippling where his shadow crossed it. Nothing here reacted like a spell. Nothing felt maintained by force.
Wind passed through the area, and the new plants swayed unevenly. Some bent too far and didn't recover. Others held. The stronger ones survived the pass. The weaker ones didn't.
Fire remained subtle, buried beneath the soil, feeding growth rather than asserting itself. He could feel it through his feet like heat held in reserve.
"Quin, look!" Lucille called with a voice full of surprise. She lifted an arm and pointed upward.
He followed her line of sight.
For the first time since the soul realm had existed, there was a sun.

It hung high above the land, a defined presence rather than an unseen source. Its light was not harsh but not so weak that it couldn't be felt either, perfect to sustain life. The light spread evenly, casting real shadows that shifted as clouds drifted past it. Warmth touched his skin in a way the realm's previous, constant illumination never had.
Quinlan let out a slow breath. "This is amazing..."
Kitsara stretched her arms over her head and rolled her shoulders, tails swishing lazily behind her. "Ohhh, it's so warm! Maybe I can get as tanned as Serika."
"You?" Seraphiel asked dryly. "Tanned?"
"What?" Kitsara scoffed, hands settling on her hips. "I could totally pull it off."
"Can't you just change your skin color with your illusion magic...?"
"It's not the same! Quin only likes to do me when I'm myself!"
"..." The blonde elf glanced up at the sun, then at Kitsara, considering it far longer than necessary. "A tanned, slutty foxy with white fur. I guess Quin would be into that."
"Isn't he basically into everything?" Iris murmured. "His taste is truly questionable."
Aurora let out a short chuckle at that. "You might have a point there."

Her gaze lingered on the sun as her smile faded into thought. "Still," she continued, more serious now, "this matters. Constant light isn't natural. Living things need cycles. Growth happens during activity, but recovery happens during rest. If this sun sets and rises as it does in our world, then these plants and animals will have periods to slow down, conserve energy, and stabilize."

She gestured toward the river, where the small fish still darted beneath the surface. "Without that, they would burn themselves out. This means the ecosystem can regulate itself and potentially blossom into a proper world of its own, with living beings inhabiting it."

Quinlan nodded. "So that's what happened." This was not a design he had planned out in detail. When the Soul Records told him he was failing to fully use what he possessed, the criticism stuck. He had power spread across too many systems that did not speak to each other. Elemental mastery. Soul dominion. Physical authority. The Soul Records had also told him that his soul was at its capacity. That gaining new powers for himself was not possible because he'd be torn apart due to reaching the limit.
Two primordial classes, two harbinger powers, two concept seeds, and more. All of it was held in a single primordial soul.
So he gambled. What if he could consolidate his powers? What if he could force his body to tear apart or adapt?
Slowing down his rate of progression was not what Quinlan wanted.

He wanted to grow quickly. If he were to be faced with the opportunity to grow stronger and again be cockblocked by a 'sorry, your vessel's capacity is too small,' he wouldn't have been one happy man, that much was for certain.
That's why the gamble occurred, the weird power symbiosis he himself didn't quite understand. But alas, it worked. His vessel grew to accommodate his powers better than his previous one.
Quinlan could already feel that his connection to his various powers deepened.
As for the gamble itself?

Infusing his soul realm with the four elements was an attempt to force interaction where none existed. Let the elements take root in a sovereign space. Let Mimi filter and stabilize the output. Then feed that refined essence back into his body instead of channeling it externally like a spell.

Doing so allowed his body to become strong enough to breed Nyxara into submission, which then allowed his physique to be upgraded to its new self. The risk paid off. 'Not that I had much of a choice...' Quinlan muttered inwardly with a dry tone. 'Either I took on some major risk or let myself be consumed by the slutty succubus.'
Quinlan's gaze shifted across the soul realm, pulled by a presence he felt before he properly saw it. 'Speaking of...'
The tree stood where it always had.

That alone should have been reassuring. Mimi's anchor. His soul guardian. The axis around which the realm stabilized. Its roots still sank deep into the land, thick and firm, threading through soil that now carried real depth.
But it was taller.
Not just stretched upward, but fuller as well, with the trunk having thickened.
However, this was not the development that made Quinlan and co raise an eyebrow.

The trunk's surface was no longer smooth in the way it once was. Vines coiled around it in spirals, dark and supple, their tips splitting into hooked tendrils that clung as they climbed. They looked alive in a way that went beyond growth. There was intent in how they wrapped, how they tightened and released, how they claimed space along the bark.
Warmth rolled off the tree in steady waves, the same warmth Quinlan had felt oozing from the demon woman as they conducted their duel.

Low on the trunk, half-hidden between two twisting vines, a symbol had burned itself into the bark. It was pink and too precise to be natural. It was the same sigil etched into Nyxara's lower abdomen, the womb mark.
His eyes tracked upward.

The branches spread wider than before, layered and dense, leaves overlapping in a canopy that filtered light instead of simply letting it pass. Nestled among them, balanced with ease, sat Nyxara herself.
She had her legs crossed and sat there with her usual, confident posture, looking as if it had always been meant to hold her. In her arms lay Mimi.
Unconscious.

The small blue-skinned girl was cradled against Nyxara's chest, head tucked beneath her chin. One of Nyxara's hands rested at Mimi's back, fingers moving in slow, careful strokes that followed the rise and fall of her breathing. The other brushed through her hair, gentle enough that it never tugged.

chapters.title: Chapter 1448 Promiscuous Demon
paragraphs: Serika took a sharp step forward.
"What are you doing to her-"
She stopped.
Just one look was enough.

Nyxara did not turn. She did not smirk. There was no teasing glint in her eyes, no provocation in her posture. Her attention remained fully on Mimi, expression softened into something that sat uncomfortably between focus and care. Every motion was restrained, precise, as if she were afraid even a careless breath might disturb the girl.
"The demon is protecting Mimi... She's cradling her..." Vex whispered with a shocked voice.
At that, Nyxara finally looked up.
Her gaze slid from Mimi's face to Vex, unhurried, eyes steady. "Why the shock?" she asked. "This 'demon' can act like a nurturing caretaker." Her tone flattened. "I'm not just a horny slut."
"You could've fooled me," Ayame murmured.
Nyxara's lips pressed together. Then she frowned. "I could've fooled myself as well..." She glanced down at Mimi again, brow knitting. "I only just found out now, too."
The sigil on the tree's trunk pulsed once.

Pink light seeped through the grooves of the womb mark, bright but controlled, spreading along the bark in thin lines that followed the vines' paths. Nyxara inhaled slowly. When she exhaled, her lips flared with an unnatural neon hue, sharp against her skin.
"I've collected enough power," she said.
She leaned down and pressed a brief kiss to Mimi's forehead.

A thin mist spilled from Nyxara's lips, pink and warm, drifting across Mimi's brow and sinking into her skin. The girl's breathing instantly evened out. The shallow tension in her frame eased. Color returned, subtle but clear.
Mimi's eyes fluttered open.
She blinked once. Then twice.
Her gaze took in leaves, branches, and light filtering through green. Then it found her.
She froze.
Nyxara returned the girl's gaze with a gentle smile. "Hello, little one. I'm Nyxara, your new partner in crime-"
"Ah!" Mimi yelped. "This woman reeks of promiscuity!"

She twisted free with surprising speed, scrambling out of Nyxara's arms and lunging from the high branch into the depths, landing straight into Serika's chest. Serika caught her without thinking, arms locking around her as Mimi buried her face against her shoulder.
Mimi peeked out a second later, eyes narrowed. "I have to treasure my innocence. Big sis Serika said so!"
Nyxara stared.
Then she sighed and looked away. "I really need to work on my image."
Quinlan finally spoke.
"Okay," he said flatly. "I'm lost. Nyxara, tell me what's going on."
Her pupils slid toward him.

The instant their eyes met, the irises deepened and bloomed into pink, heart-shaped irises that throbbed once, then again, responding to his presence alone. The softness she had worn for Mimi melted away. Her lips curved, slow and deliberate, and she dragged her tongue across them with no attempt at subtlety.
The markings along Quinlan's skin flared.
Heat surged.

Nyxara dissolved into the sigils like ink pulled into water and reformed a heartbeat later behind him, coming out of his markings with her arms sliding around his neck. Her body pressed close, chest against his back and bosom against his neck, with her breath warm at his ear. She kissed his cheek lovingly.
"My Ruin is back... Or should I call you Master?❤️"
"I asked you a question," Quinlan replied. "Answer it."
Nyxara froze.
She pulled back just enough to look at him with her lower lip pushed out. "Tch. No appreciation at all."

Then she gasped, eyes widening. "That's right! I was mad at you!" She jabbed a finger at his cheeks, full of accusation. "You shut me off! You silenced me! Do you have any idea how sad I became? What do you have to say in your defense?"
"You were annoying," Quinlan said without hesitation.
Her spine shuddered.

The heart-shaped pupils pulsed violently alongside the womb mark as she sucked in a breath. She leaned close again, lips brushing his ear as she whispered, voice trembling, "I need you to take me right here, right now..."
He didn't move.

Instead, he turned his head just enough to look back at her with one eye. "Explain yourself. But before that," he added with his eyes flicking toward the blue-skinned woman still held carefully in his arms, "can you heal Scar like you healed Mimi?"
Nyxara stiffened.
Slowly, she withdrew, fully stepping out of his markings and landing barefoot on the warm grass. The glow dimmed. Her shoulders sagged as she crossed her arms dramatically.
"I am a poor, neglected housewife," she whimpered mournfully, "living in a household where the spark has died-"
"Bitch," Vex cut in immediately, unimpressed. "You're no wife of anyone, especially not my man. Don't get ideas."
Nyxara grinned. "A kitty is hissing. How cute."
Vex's eyes narrowed into dangerous slits. Before anything could escalate, Quinlan spoke.
"Nyxara. I am loyal to my wives. I suggest you do not taunt them."
The demon froze mid-purr.

Her grin faltered. Her shoulders drooped. She pressed a hand to her chest dramatically and sniffed. "From a primordial demon, I've become a concubine beneath the main girls... Oh, this cruel fate of mine..."
"Nyxara," Quinlan said again, firmer this time.

She burst into giggles, showing just how much of an act she was putting on. Her feet touched the ground properly as she turned toward Scar. She repeated the same ritual. The womb sigil on the tree pulsed faintly. Nyxara leaned in, breath warm, and let a thin veil of pink mist drift over Scar's face.
Scar's eyes parted.
She blinked, then focused on Quinlan, who was still holding her in a careful carry. "Master... What's going on?"
"You passed out while helping me. Do you remember?"
Her brow creased. Then her eyes lit. "Ah. I was summoned to help you defeat the promiscuous demon."
"Hello~" Nyxara sang from the side and even waved happily.
Scar turned her head. "Yeah. Her."
Then her eyes widened. "Wait. Master. We won?!"
Quinlan smiled. "Yes. Thanks to you."
Scar shook her head quickly. "It was only a small part. Any soul soldier could've done it."
"I doubt that~" Nyxara purred.
"Shush, demon," Scar hissed.
"For once, I agree with the succubus," Quinlan smiled.
Scar stiffened and looked away. "Th-thank you, Master. I can walk now."
He set her down gently.

Scar took a step. Then another. Unsteady at first, then in full control of her body. She rolled her shoulders once and straightened her spine, clearly restored. As she walked off, she kept her gaze carefully forward, very aware of several amused looks following her. She did not dare look at any of Quinlan's girls, as she knew many of them were curious to find out how she felt about being in a princess hold.
Her pace picked up just a bit.
After watching his Elite Soul walk around aimlessly for a few seconds, Quinlan turned back to Nyxara.
"Now," he said, "explain yourself."
Nyxara pouted. "You're so much warmer when you talk to literally any other woman. You're so unfair! I demand equality!"
"Nyxara."
She rubbed her thighs together at the sound of her name spoken so firmly, then sighed. "Fine. I'll behave. What happened was..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1449 Explanation
paragraphs: Nyxara clasped her hands together and sighed loud enough to be theatrical.
"After you so cruelly silenced me," she shot Quinlan a wounded look, "I complained. At length. With passion. You ignored me completely."
"Being ignored is very traumatic for a demon of my refinement. So I did the only thing left to me. I looked inward. That is when I noticed something curious."
She spread her arms and slowly turned in place.
"This," she grinned brightly, gesturing at the endless expanse, "is my home now."
Silence followed.
Quinlan frowned slightly. "Does it mean you became a resident like Mimi?"

The little blue lady couldn't leave his realm, being locked in place. She was unlike Rosie, who could traverse the realms at her will. Quinlan believed it to be the result of Mimi being created from the corpse of Serika's fallen sister; she became bound to the realm when she became what she is today.
"Yes, I believe so," Nyxara nodded.
"I don't get why all this is happening," Quinlan sighed. "Is this because of your Shriek of Ruin?"

Her grin returned, bright and unapologetic. "A succubus' Shriek of Ruin is acceptance of total surrender. Body. Spirit. Function. We yield everything and become one with our conqueror. Isn't it so romantic? Becoming inseparable...❤️"
She reached out and tapped two fingers against his chest, right over his heart. "Normally, that means dissolution. I would no longer exist as I am now."
Quinlan frowned. "Dissolution?"

"Mhm," Nyxara hummed. "My form would break down and spread through you. Bloodstream. Nerves. Thought pathways. I would become a companion bound to your core with the role of advising you, nudging your decisions when it mattered. Perhaps even empowering you. That's what happened at first, remember? I became small particles and entered your body."
Seraphiel lifted an eyebrow. "You, a supporter?"
Nyxara smiled wider. "Guide, anchor, amplifier, soul mate. Whatever you want to call it."
Multiple eyes narrowed at the term 'soul mate.'
"The primordial succubus as a guide," Seraphiel mused flatly.
Nyxara turned her head and squinted at her. "Excuse you. I am very knowledgeable, I'll have you know."
Her eyes dropped lower.
"...Blonde elf with big tits."
Seraphiel stiffened instantly. "Keep your eyes away, sex demon. Only Quin gets to tarnish my innocence."
Nyxara licked her lips. "You and innocence in the same sentence? You're fooling no one, especially not me, miss~ I can smell kinks oozing from your core from over here~" "Daughter?" Sylvaris gasped.
"This is getting old!" Seraphiel cried. She kept getting exposed in front of her very traditional and judgmental mother!!

Nyxara grinned and finally looked back at Quinlan, clearly feeling victorious. "As I was saying. That would have been the end state. I would exist inside you as a constant presence. And before you ask why, it's because the Shriek of Ruin is shaped by both the succubus and the conqueror. If you were already a finished being, firmly rooted in your path, our union would have settled differently, perhaps."
She smiled tenderly at him. "But you're not."
Quinlan understood. "I'm still at the beginning of my path. An age-old demon in my head giving advice would be a really strong advantage. It would make our union incredibly important to me."

Nyxara purred softly. "Exactly. It is in our nature to make ourselves indispensable to our conqueror. No succubus wants to be a forgotten ornament. We become what our conqueror needs. That way, we protect ourselves from being mistreated."
Her eyes narrowed playfully.
"...Or worse. Neglected."
She lifted a finger and poked his chest, right over his heart. Once. Then again. A little harder than necessary. "Which you are absolutely guilty of."

Quinlan grinned. "I just conquered a primordial demon after conducting a life-or-death battle against her, where she tried to consume me and reshape my physique. Forgive me if I didn't schedule cuddle time."
She gasped, scandalized, then jabbed him once more for emphasis. "Excuses!"
He shrugged, calm and unrepentant. "I'm just getting used to all of this. But I get it now."
Nyxara looked at him expectantly, waiting for his words.
"I'll try to... tolerate your existence."
Silence.
Nyxara's eyes widened. Her lips trembled. She clutched at her chest dramatically. "T–tolerate...?"
She took a half step back, shoulders slumping as if struck by tragedy. "Ah. So this is my fate. Reduced to merely being tolerated!"
Her lower lip quivered. "I give my soul, my ruin, my eternal loyalty, and this is what I receive..."

Quinlan had to admit it. From her perspective, she had made some good points. Whether he liked it or not, they conducted steamy bedroom warfare - to which he consented - and they came away in their current state.
Even if he didn't know it'd end up like this, Quinlan felt it was his job to accept responsibility.

Nyxara was attached to him now. Permanently, by every definition that mattered. Continuing to treat her like a nuisance or even a parasite sat wrong in his chest. She had not betrayed him, merely accepted her role as the one he had to defeat in the trial.

She had not harmed his lovers beyond uttering some sharp words and posturing, which was basically par for the course when it came to the women he decided to surround himself with. Many of his ladies were feisty creatures. So, yeah... That was all the 'wrong' Nyxara did.
Basically, nothing.
At least, as far as he was concerned. That's why, at this very moment, Quinlan decided he would stop bullying his succubus companion. For the time being.
Perhaps.
He exhaled, stepped closer, and lifted a hand.
Nyxara froze mid-accusation.

His palm came down on her head, fingers resting lightly in her hair. "Alright. I'll admit you're not speaking complete nonsense. I won't just tolerate you. I'll appreciate you for who you are, Nyxara."
Nyxara blinked.
Once.
Twice.
Her tail stilled. Her hands stopped poking his chest. For a heartbeat, she simply stared up at him as if he'd spoken a language she hadn't prepared for.

Then she squeaked and launched herself at him. "KYAAA!!!" Arms locked around his neck. Lips everywhere. Warm pressure along his jaw, his collar, the side of his throat. Too many quick kisses to count. Too many hickies left to mark him as hers.
"I love you!" she declared between kisses. "I loooove you!❤️ Stupid, arrogant Ruin of mine!!❤️❤️ You better live up to your word, okay?! Men who fail to do so are no men at all!"
Quinlan sighed while his arms came up to hold her. "I know."
"Good~" She hummed happily against his neck.

He took the barrage of unfiltered emotions for a few seconds before speaking again. "Okay. So you're my guide now. My... supporter." His gaze shifted slightly. "Then why are you here? You should be inside my body, living in your pink mark on my back, right? That's how you described it."
Nyxara finally pulled back. Her euphoric expression softened, turning ever so slightly more focused.
"That was exactly how it happened. I entered you, I threaded myself through your blood, your nerves, your thoughts. That's why we could converse even after my body disintegrated."
Her fingers traced lightly along his arm as she spoke, still extremely flirtatious.
"But then your physique responded." She clicked her tongue. "It declared war and pushed back. Hard."
"A second connection formed," Quinlan said quietly.
She nodded. "A symbiosis. Your Primordial Breeding Physique did not just take from me. It changed with me. That was when your new physique was born."
Her eyes lifted, gleaming. "And during that process, something opened."

chapters.title: Chapter 1450 Nyxara's Declaration
paragraphs: Her eyes lifted, gleaming. "And during that process, something opened."
She shifted her weight and tapped the ground beneath them with her toes. "Your soul realm. It allowed me in. It invited me to become an integral part of it."
Ayame frowned slightly. "Wait, does this mean you can't manifest outside the realm?"
If she could, that would basically mean the entire continent of Iskaris became solved. With Nyxara helping them, literally nothing could step in their way.
Even among the primordials, Nyxara was considered one of the strongest.
Then what about mortals who were locked to level 74 or below?
It'd be a massacre, the kind history had never recorded before.
"I tried," Nyxara said, shrugging. "Didn't work. Maybe I'll find a way."
A subtle stillness passed through the group. No one said anything in response. A few gazes dropped.
Nyxara noticed immediately.

She straightened and laughed. "Oh, stop that. There's no need for pity. Normally, releasing a Shriek of Ruin means losing one's form forever. I would exist only within my conqueror, never walking on my own again."
Her smile widened. "This bond lets me keep all of that and more."

She returned to Quinlan's side and hooked an arm through his, with her cheek resting lightly against him. "I can guide you from within as it was supposed to happen, and as a boon I'll be forever happy about, I can still exist here. After all, you still carry my mark. It has just evolved to become more."
Her voice dipped, pleased. "I can act as your guide yet also hug and kiss you whenever I want."
She then sent him a truly suspicious gaze before adding, "That is, as long as my cruel Ruin doesn't silence me and also visits me here."
Quinlan reached out to pet her head for a second time. "I won't promise anything. If you don't behave..."

"So cruel!" Nyxara whined, though her smile betrayed her. She rose onto her toes, brushed a quick kiss against his cheek, and leaned in close enough that only he heard her sultry whisper. "I'll be a good girl then❤️ Just for you❤️Forget anyone else-"
"Khm!!" A pointed cough cut in.
Vex had her arms crossed.
Nyxara stopped at once. "Okay, okay. Don't taunt the wives. I remember." She glanced back at Quinlan, eyes bright with mischief. "See? I can behave!"
She turned and began to walk away, hips swaying with deliberate sensuality. "Come, Ruin. Let me welcome you into your domain properly, as is your right as my conqueror."
"Welcome me properly?" Quinlan raised an eyebrow but followed anyway. They stopped beneath Mimi's tree.

The vines wrapped around its trunk reacted as soon as Nyxara flicked her finger. They shifted and uncoiled, moving with purpose. The playful edge in her posture faded. Her back straightened. Her voice lost its teasing tone.
"{The Master Hath Returned}" she spoke with a unique tone, sounding as if she were chanting words from an ancient ritual rather than conversing normally as before.
At Nyxara's call, the demonic vines hugging Mimi's tree answered.

Thicker strands peeled away from the trunk first, sliding down. They layered over one another, braiding into rigid supports. Smaller tendrils threaded between them, locking the structure in place. Plates of dark bark folded outward and hardened, forming armrests and a high back that rose just enough to frame whoever sat there.
The seat finished shaping itself last.

It curved inward, shaped to hold in comfort, the surface smoothing where it mattered and remaining rough where it did not. The throne settled with roots driving into the soil beneath it as if claiming permanence.

Nyxara turned to face Quinlan. "This is your seat of power. Will you take it?" Quinlan understood this was no act. The demon was more serious than ever before. This was not the time for snarky remarks. Having already decided he'll treat this woman well, he stepped forward and sat without comment. Once settled, he watched the demon kneel in silence.
There was no sense of intrusion in his heart, no sense of something being strange.
Instead, a thought deep in him responded with quiet certainty.
'This feels right.'
His Abyssal Genesis Physique simply accepted the position as correct, as if this was where he was meant to sit.
Nyxara lifted her head to look into his eyes, still kneeling.
"I, Nyxara, Primordial Demon of Lust, swear myself to you."
"I offer my will, my guidance, my strength, and my existence. I will stand within you and beside you. I will guard your ascent, sharpen your intent, and never act against your dominion."
"My Shriek of Ruin has bound me to you. But this vow is my choice, made of my free will."
The demonic markings along his body stirred on impulse. He felt it answer before he even did.
Quinlan did not rush his reply, looking at the kneeling woman for a good few seconds, taking it all in.
'Is this okay? Is this really what I want?'
Then he scoffed inwardly. 'What useless thoughts.'
"I, Quinlan Elysiar," he said at last, voice calm and clear, "Primordial Villain, Harbinger of Ruin, Godslayer, hear and accept your vow."
The throne beneath him responded by releasing unseen pressure.
"I claim your loyalty, not as a tool, but as a bond. Your place is acknowledged. Your existence is secured."
Now, it was the marking etching her own body that flared, just once, in perfect synch with the beat of her heart.
Then it faded.
Nyxara's shoulders shook.
A single tear slipped free and fell to the ground between them.
"What's wrong?" Quinlan asked.
She laughed softly and wiped at her cheek with the back of her hand. "Nothing's wrong, my love..."
She looked up at him again, eyes clear.

"For a succubus, releasing a Shriek of Ruin is the greatest gamble we could ever take. With the right conqueror, our lives become more satisfying than we could ever imagine. With the wrong one, it becomes endless suffering."
She swallowed, then smiled.
"I can tell... I got the best one."
For the first time, Quinlan saw her smile not as the sultry grin of a hungry demon, but as the beautiful smile of a wonderful woman.
Just like this, he kept looking at her without speaking.
The silence stretched. He studied her face as it was now, without provocation or hunger shaping it. Then he let his expression ease and returned the genuine smile she gave him.
He reached forward and patted his own thigh.
"Come," he said. "Your place is not at my feet."
Nyxara froze.

"!!!" Then she squealed. Her body scattered into soft pink particles that pulled inward toward Quinlan's chest. A heartbeat later, the markings along his skin flared, and she reformed in his lap, seated sideways, arms already looped around his neck.
She pressed her forehead against his neck, staying there while dangling her legs joyously.
No teasing. No flirting.
Just contentment.
Quinlan wrapped an arm around her back and another around her legs, holding her properly. Her warmth seeped through him.
The way she leaned into his hold told him more than words ever would. She trusted him. She depended on him.
He accepted that weight.
'I won't make her regret taking the vow,' he decided.
Nyxara stayed where she was, feeling more satisfied than she ever had in her billions of years of life.
With this settled, Quinlan's focus shifted forward.
There was still some time to spend with the primordials. And then he would return to Thalorind.
A continental war was waiting.
The endgame of Iskaris was about to begin.
